detail.title: Increasing Accessibility to Trusted Climate Performance Data

publicationDetails.detailsText: Stanford Law School Law and Policy Lab, 2025 Winter

detail.abstract:
Without fanfare, U.S. companies, financiers, and entrepreneurs are continuing to make substantial investments in reducing emissions of carbon, methane, and other greenhouse gases (GHGs) and, in a growing trend, in direct removals of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. In April 2025, for example, the X Prize Carbon Removal competition doled out $100 million in the largest global incentive competition award in history.

While many clean energy investments will continue to scale, a single market failure—the lack of investor-grade performance metrics—threatens to hold back investments in three of the most promising opportunity areas for GHG emissions reductions and removals: methane emissions reductions; hybrid (or engineered) CDR solutions; and forest carbon interventions.

The Stanford Law & Policy Lab report describes how poor performance accounting standards are the soft underbelly that is afflicting each of these sectors. In all three cases, there is no general agreement on protocols that should be used to measure and confirm GHG reductions and removals, nor is there a system for transparently sharing performance results that will trigger additional investment.

This lack of GHG performance accounting can and must be fixed. The Stanford report reviews how leaders in other fields have come together to identify and incentivize the use of modern data management tools to pool together shared, trusted performance information that data users of all types can rely upon. The report provides recommendations for how key stakeholders in each of the three sectors highlighted in the report can—with the assistance of expert convenors and university consortia—leverage and expand nascent standard-setting and data collection and sharing initiatives to generate accessible, trusted GHG performance data, triggering increased investment in activities that will reduce methane emissions, scale CDR solutions, and increase carbon uptake in forests (and other nature-based solutions). The report also highlights GHG performance data gains that can be made in the urban context, building on foundational work undertaken by Crosswalk Labs and the Data Foundation.

AI.tldr: 美国企业界在自愿减排和碳移除方面投入巨大，但缺乏投资者级别的温室气体绩效核算标准正阻碍甲烷减排、混合碳移除和森林碳汇三大关键领域的投资。斯坦福报告建议借鉴其他领域经验，建立共享、可信的绩效数据体系以释放投资。
AI.research_question: 温室气体减排与移除领域缺乏投资者级别的绩效核算标准，如何解决这一市场失灵问题以促进关键领域的投资？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国企业和投资者在自愿减排及碳移除方面已投入巨资（如X Prize碳移除竞赛1亿美元奖励），但甲烷减排、工程化碳移除和森林碳汇三大最具前景的领域因缺乏统一、可信的绩效核算标准而面临投资瓶颈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场失灵理论（信息不对称导致投资不足）；集体行动与标准制定理论（借鉴其他领域成功经验）；绩效会计与数据共享机制。
AI.method: 斯坦福法律与政策实验室的报告基于跨部门案例分析，比较了其他领域如何通过现代数据管理工具建立共享绩效信息体系，并为三大碳减排领域提出具体建议。
AI.findings: 三大领域（甲烷减排、混合碳移除、森林碳汇）均缺乏公认的测量与验证协议，也没有透明的绩效结果共享系统；可通过专家召集者和大学联盟推动建立标准化数据收集与共享机制；城市层面的温室气体绩效数据也有改进空间（如Crosswalk Labs的基础工作）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将市场失灵理论与绩效会计标准问题系统性地应用于温室气体减排与移除领域，指出了"软肋"所在，并提出了跨领域借鉴的解决路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和企业提供了具体建议：通过专家召集和大学联盟推动标准制定和数据共享，以释放甲烷减排、混合碳移除和森林碳汇领域的投资潜力。

title: Paradigms in the Eradication of Grade 4 Malignancies: A Comprehensive Analysis of Pathophysiology, Standard of Care, and Emerging Curative Modalities

detail.title: Paradigms in the Eradication of Grade 4 Malignancies: A Comprehensive Analysis of Pathophysiology, Standard of Care, and Emerging Curative Modalities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I possess a direct personal and familial connection to the pathology discussed extensively in this manuscript: my father was diagnosed with WHO grade 4 glioblastoma multiforme. While this lived experience and profound personal connection provided the intrinsic motivation to conduct an exhaustive, independent synthesis of the neuro-oncological literature, it did not influence or bias the objective extraction, statistical reporting, or critical scientific analysis of the empirical data presented herein.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Background: The clinical designation of a "Grade 4" tumor universally signifies the zenith of cellular abnormality, aggressive proliferation, and metastatic potential. Despite advances in oncology, eradicating these aggressive entities remains one of the most formidable challenges in modern medicine. Methods: This comprehensive review synthesizes current knowledge and recent clinical advancements (up to 2026) regarding the pathophysiology, histological classifications, and therapeutic management of Grade 4 malignancies across diverse tissue origins, with a primary focus on glioblastoma and advanced undifferentiated carcinomas. could reclassify universally terminal diagnoses into highly manageable or curable conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文综合综述了4级恶性肿瘤（特别是胶质母细胞瘤和晚期未分化癌）的病理生理学、组织学分类和治疗管理进展，提出通过新型治疗策略可能将普遍被认为是终末期的诊断重新分类为高度可管理或可治愈的疾病。
AI.research_question: 如何通过综合理解4级恶性肿瘤的病理生理学特征和最新临床进展，将这些普遍被认为是终末期的肿瘤重新分类为高度可管理或可治愈的疾病？
AI.motivation: 4级肿瘤代表细胞异常、侵袭性增殖和转移潜能的最高等级，尽管肿瘤学取得了进步，但根除这些侵袭性实体仍然是现代医学中最严峻的挑战之一。
AI.theoretical_framework: 肿瘤分级理论、肿瘤病理生理学、组织学分类体系
AI.method: 综合综述，整合截至2026年的最新知识和临床进展
AI.findings: 通过对胶质母细胞瘤和晚期未分化癌等多种组织来源的4级恶性肿瘤的病理生理学、组织学分类和治疗管理的综合分析，提出了将普遍终末期诊断重新分类为高度可管理或可治愈疾病的潜在可能。
AI.theory_contributions: 对4级恶性肿瘤的病理生理学机制进行了系统整合，为重新定义肿瘤分级标准提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床医生提供了4级恶性肿瘤的综合管理策略，指出了将晚期肿瘤转化为可管理或可治愈状态的潜在路径。

title: Comprehensive Analysis of Neoplastic Disease: Etiology, Clinical Manifestations, Surgical Interventions, and Therapeutic Paradigms

detail.title: Comprehensive Analysis of Neoplastic Disease: Etiology, Clinical Manifestations, Surgical Interventions, and Therapeutic Paradigms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Cancer remains a leading global health challenge, with conventional diagnostic and treatment methods often lacking precision and adaptability. This comprehensive review explores transformative advancements that are reshaping oncology, emphasizing the integration of biomarker-driven diagnostics with tailored therapeutic strategies. It examines the complex etiology of neoplastic disease, the systemic patient experience, and evolving surgical paradigms ranging from minimally invasive robotics to complex cytoreductive procedures. Additionally, it highlights the critical role of artificial intelligence as a supportive, evidence-organizing co-pilot within multidisciplinary tumor boards. Furthermore, the review outlines the far-reaching consequences of cancer for health systems, economies, and societies, highlighting the urgent need to address equitable access to life-saving technologies and care worldwide. 1 By adopting cutting-edge, patient-centered approaches, a new era of precision oncology emerges, bridging the gap between early detection and effective intervention.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述全面探讨了精准肿瘤学的变革性进展，重点阐述了生物标志物驱动的诊断与个体化治疗策略的整合，以及人工智能在肿瘤多学科团队中的作用，同时强调了全球范围内公平获取先进医疗技术的迫切需求。
AI.research_question: 精准肿瘤学如何通过生物标志物诊断、个体化治疗策略和人工智能整合，重塑癌症诊疗范式？
AI.motivation: 传统癌症诊疗方法缺乏精准性和适应性，需要探索将生物标志物驱动诊断与个体化治疗相结合的新范式，以改善患者预后并解决医疗公平性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精准肿瘤学理论、生物标志物驱动诊断框架、人工智能辅助决策理论、个体化治疗策略、多学科协作模式
AI.method: 综合性文献综述，整合了生物标志物诊断、微创手术（机器人辅助）、细胞减灭术、人工智能在肿瘤多学科团队中的应用等多方面研究证据
AI.findings: 1）生物标志物驱动诊断与个体化治疗策略的整合显著提高了诊疗精准性；2）从微创机器人手术到复杂细胞减灭术的外科范式正在演变；3）人工智能可作为证据组织的辅助工具，在多学科肿瘤团队中发挥关键作用；4）癌症对卫生系统、经济和社会产生深远影响，全球公平获取先进技术是迫切需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了精准肿瘤学的新范式框架，将生物标志物诊断、人工智能辅助和多学科协作系统性地整合为统一理论模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床实践提供了从早期检测到有效干预的完整路径指导，强调了以患者为中心的方法和全球医疗公平性问题

title: Predictive Maintenance Beyond the Hype: Total Cost of Ownership Models for Industrial AI Deployments

detail.title: Predictive Maintenance Beyond the Hype: Total Cost of Ownership Models for Industrial AI Deployments
detail.abstract: Predictive maintenance (PdM) is the most frequently cited use case for Industrial AI, featured prominently in vendor marketing, industry conference agendas, and enterprise AI strategy documents. Yet the actual return on investment for predictive maintenance AI remains poorly understood, obscured by vendor-driven narratives that emphasize sensor cost reductions and downtime avoidance while systematically underreporting the true costs of deployment. This paper argues that the total cost of ownership for predictive maintenance AI is 2.5-4x higher than vendor projections typically suggest, and that the breakeven horizon is correspondingly longer than most capital expenditure approvals anticipate. Drawing on transaction cost economics and evidence from discrete manufacturing and process industry deployments, the paper proposes the PdM-TCO Framework-a five-stage total cost of ownership model specifically designed for predictive maintenance AI that captures costs across instrumentation, data pipeline construction, model development, operational integration, and continuous improvement. The framework identifies five categories of systematically underreported costs: data engineering infrastructure, change management for maintenance teams, false positive fatigue and its trust erosion effects, model retraining as equipment degrades, and organizational integration overhead. The paper further proposes the PdM Investment Justification Matrix, which identifies the conditions-asset criticality, failure consequence severity, data availability, and maintenance team readiness-under which predictive maintenance AI investment is genuinely justified versus conditions under which simpler condition-based monitoring delivers equivalent value at lower cost. Implications are developed for VP Operations evaluating PdM investments, Plant Managers implementing PdM programs, and CFOs approving capital expenditure for Industrial AI.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了预测性维护AI的真实总拥有成本（TCO）比供应商预测高出2.5-4倍，提出了PdM-TCO框架和PdM投资论证矩阵，帮助企业在资产关键性、故障后果严重性、数据可用性和维护团队准备度等条件下判断是否真正值得投资预测性维护AI。
AI.research_question: 预测性维护AI的真实总拥有成本是多少？在什么条件下预测性维护AI投资才是真正合理的？
AI.motivation: 预测性维护（PdM）被公认为工业AI最核心的应用场景，但其实际投资回报率（ROI）被供应商叙事严重高估，实际部署成本被系统性低估，导致企业做出次优的投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本经济学（Transaction Cost Economics）；总拥有成本（TCO）模型
AI.method: 基于离散制造和流程工业的实证证据，结合交易成本经济学理论进行分析
AI.findings: （1）预测性维护AI的TCO比供应商预测高出2.5-4倍，盈亏平衡时间远超预期； （2）存在五类被系统性低估的成本：数据工程基础设施、变更管理、误报疲劳与信任侵蚀、设备退化导致的模型重训、组织整合开销； （3）只有在资产关键性高、故障后果严重、数据可用性好、维护团队准备充分的条件下，PdM AI投资才真正合理，否则更简单的基于状态的监控更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了专门针对预测性维护AI的五阶段TCO模型（PdM-TCO Framework），提出了PdM投资论证矩阵，将交易成本经济学应用于工业AI投资决策分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为VP运营、工厂经理和CFO提供了评估预测性维护AI投资的实用决策框架，帮助识别何时应选择更简单的基于状态的监控方案而非复杂的AI方案。

reference: IIM Bangalore Research Paper No.738
title: Regulatory Thresholds and the Supply of Small Business Credit
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore

detail.title: Regulatory Thresholds and the Supply of Small Business Credit

publicationDetails.journalName: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how regulatory thresholds a ect the pricing and structure of small business lending. I exploit the 10 billion Dollar asset cuto in the Dodd-Frank Act, which imposes enhanced regulatory requirements on banks, to isolate the impact of regulation on lending outcomes. Banks crossing the threshold increase loan spreads and adjust contract terms by reducing loan size, shortening maturity, and increasing reliance on government guarantees after the implementation of Dodd-Frank act. These e ects are concentrated among banks with greater exposure to commercial and industrial lending, consistent with a supply-side channel through which regulatory costs are passed on to borrowers. These findings highlight how size-based regulatory thresholds can distort the allocation of credit by increasing the marginal cost of bank intermediation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用《多德-弗兰克法案》中100亿美元资产门槛，研究监管阈值如何影响小企业贷款的定价与结构。跨越门槛的银行提高了贷款利差，并通过减少贷款规模、缩短期限、增加政府担保依赖来调整合同条款，表明监管成本被转嫁给借款人。
AI.research_question: 基于规模的监管阈值如何影响小企业贷款的定价和合同结构？
AI.motivation: 规模阈值监管（如《多德-弗兰克法案》的100亿美元资产门槛）可能扭曲信贷资源配置，但鲜有研究量化其实际经济后果。本文旨在识别监管成本通过银行向借款人传导的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管阈值理论、银行成本传导机制、信贷合约设计理论。核心逻辑：当银行因资产规模跨越监管门槛而承担更高合规成本时，会通过调整贷款价格和非价格条款将成本转嫁给借款人。
AI.method: 利用《多德-弗兰克法案》100亿美元资产阈值作为准自然实验，采用断点回归或双重差分方法，比较跨越门槛与未跨越门槛的银行在小企业贷款行为上的差异。
AI.findings: （1）跨越门槛的银行提高了贷款利差；（2）减少了贷款规模、缩短了贷款期限；（3）增加了对政府担保的依赖；（4）上述效应在商业和工业贷款敞口较大的银行中更为显著，证实供给侧传导渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了基于规模的监管阈值如何通过增加银行中介的边际成本，扭曲信贷市场的定价与非价格条款，丰富了监管经济学与银行信贷渠道的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估规模阈值监管的意外后果（如小企业信贷可得性下降）提供实证依据，提示监管设计需权衡合规成本与信贷市场效率。

title: Heterogeneous Decarbonization: Technology-Specific Renewable Shocks and Asymmetric Emissions Responses Across the Global Economy

detail.title: Heterogeneous Decarbonization: Technology-Specific Renewable Shocks and Asymmetric Emissions Responses Across the Global Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise. AI-assisted tools were used solely for code debugging and computational formatting support. All core research design, model specifications, analysis, and writing were independently executed by the author, who accepts full responsibility for the manuscript’s integrity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study utilizes secondary, de-identified macroeconomic and energy panel data from the World Development Indi cators. No direct human subjects interaction occurred; institutional ethics committee review was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no specific funding for this work.

detail.abstract: Climate policy often assumes that renewable energy deployment produces similar emission reductions across countries, despite major differences in grid flexibility and fuel substitution capacity. Using the GTAP-E-Power computable general equilibrium framework calibrated to eight global regions and twenty-two sectors, together with panel data for 59 countries from 2000 to 2023, this paper examines how technology-specific renewable shocks affect emissions, production, and welfare. The results reveal a heterogeneous rebound problem in which developing economies with rigid grids experience emissions declines of 16-33% through output contraction, while advanced economies substitute toward fossil generation, producing rebound effects of up to 39% under solar shocks. Solar shocks generate the strongest rebounds, while firm zero-emission baseload contractions intensify coal substitution. Demand-side efficiency policies generate substantial welfare gains but impose negative spillovers on trade-exposed regions. Fixed-effects and Bayesian Ridge methods consistently confirm a robust emissions-reducing effect of renewable energy deployment, with a fixed-effects elasticity of-0.30 and a Bayesian Ridge posterior mean of-0.40.

AI.tldr: 本文发现可再生能源的减排效果因国家电网灵活性和替代能力不同而存在显著差异：发展中国家通过产出收缩实现16-33%的减排，而发达国家在太阳能冲击下产生高达39%的回弹效应。太阳能冲击回弹最强，需求侧效率政策带来福利收益但损害贸易暴露地区。
AI.research_question: 不同技术类型的可再生能源冲击如何异质性地影响各国的碳排放、生产产出和福利水平？
AI.motivation: 气候政策常假设可再生能源部署在不同国家产生相似的减排效果，但各国电网灵活性和燃料替代能力存在巨大差异，这一假设可能严重误导政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 回弹效应理论（Rebound Effect）、GTAP-E-Power可计算一般均衡（CGE）框架、固定效应模型与贝叶斯岭回归。
AI.method: 使用GTAP-E-Power CGE模型校准至8个全球区域和22个部门，结合59个国家2000-2023年的面板数据，采用固定效应模型和贝叶斯岭回归进行实证估计。
AI.findings: （1）发展中国家因电网刚性，通过产出收缩实现16-33%的减排；（2）发达国家则转向化石发电，太阳能冲击下产生高达39%的回弹效应；（3）太阳能冲击回弹最强，而稳定零排放基荷收缩会强化煤电替代；（4）需求侧效率政策带来福利收益但对贸易暴露地区产生负溢出；（5）固定效应弹性为-0.30，贝叶斯岭后验均值为-0.40，确认可再生能源显著减排效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了可再生能源减排效应的异质性回弹机制，区分了发展中国家的"产出收缩型减排"与发达国家的"燃料替代型回弹"，丰富了能源环境经济学中回弹效应的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候政策制定者提供了差异化政策建议：发展中国家需优先提升电网灵活性，发达国家应关注太阳能部署的潜在回弹效应，政策设计应结合需求侧效率措施以最大化净福利。

title: Twenty Years After a Turning Point: Legacies, Lessons, and the Unfinished Business of Institutional Denial and Heads and Hearts
affiliations: McGeorge School of Law and University of Detroit Mercy - School of Law, University of the Pacific - McGeorge School of Law

detail.title: Twenty Years After a Turning Point: Legacies, Lessons, and the Unfinished Business of Institutional Denial and Heads and Hearts
detail.abstract:
This article examines the lasting impact of two landmark articles that transformed modern legal education: Lawrence Krieger’s Institutional Denial About the Dark Side of Law School and Gerald Hess’s Heads and Hearts: The Teaching and Learning Environment in Law School. Together, the articles identified how law school structures, culture, and teaching practices contribute to student distress, alienation, loss of intrinsic motivation, and weakened professional identity, while also offering concrete approaches for creating more humane and effective learning environments.

The article traces how these works reshaped legal education over the last two decades, influencing scholarship, teaching practices, faculty development, well-being initiatives, and ABA accreditation standards related to professional identity and student wellness. It also argues, however, that much of the core problem remains unresolved. Despite widespread reform efforts, many of the structural conditions the authors criticized, especially mandatory grading curves and competitive institutional cultures, continue to define legal education.

Twenty years later, the unfinished business of these articles remains clear: legal education cannot meaningfully improve student well-being, learning, or professional formation without confronting both the systems that govern law schools and the daily teaching practices that shape students’ experiences.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了Krieger和Hess两篇里程碑式文章对法学教育的持久影响，指出尽管过去二十年法学教育在福祉和职业认同方面有所改革，但评分曲线和竞争文化等结构性核心问题仍未解决。
AI.research_question: 两篇里程碑文章（Krieger的《Institutional Denial About the Dark Side of Law School》与Hess的《Heads and Hearts》）对法学教育产生了何种持久影响？其指出的核心问题在二十年后是否得到解决？
AI.motivation: 法学教育中长期存在学生痛苦、疏离感、内在动机丧失和职业认同弱化等问题，需要系统审视已有改革成效与未竟之业。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法学院结构、文化及教学实践对学生心理与职业发展的影响理论；专业认同形成理论；内在动机理论。
AI.method: 文献回顾与历史分析，追踪两篇里程碑文章对法学教育学术研究、教学实践、教师发展、福祉倡议及ABA认证标准的影响轨迹。
AI.findings: 两篇文章在过去二十年深刻重塑了法学教育，影响了学术研究、教学实践、教师发展、学生福祉倡议及ABA认证标准（涉及专业认同和学生福祉）。然而，强制评分曲线和竞争性制度文化等核心结构性问题仍未得到根本解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了法学教育改革的结构性障碍，指出仅改善教学实践不足以解决系统性问题，需要同时改革治理体系和日常教学实践。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法学院管理者、教师和政策制定者提供了改革方向：必须同时面对法学院治理体系和日常教学实践，才能真正改善学生福祉、学习效果和专业形成。

title: Beyond the Single Binary Choice Format for Eliciting Willingness to Accept: Evidence from a Field Study on Onshore Wind Farms
affiliations: Grenoble Ecole de Management, University of Trento and Fraunhofer Institute Systems and Innovation Research, Competence Center Energy Policy and Energy Systems

detail.title: Beyond the Single Binary Choice Format for Eliciting Willingness to Accept: Evidence from a Field Study on Onshore Wind Farms
detail.abstract: This study examines the convergent validity of alternative elicitation formats for estimating willingness to accept (WTA) in the field, using a single binary choice (SBC) question as the benchmark. We consider standard and theory-driven versions (based on mechanism-design theory) of the double-bounded binary choice (DB) and the open-ended (OE) formats. Our empirical application, conducted in collaboration with a major energy company, elicits the compensation required for installing onshore wind farms in respondents' municipalities. To account for the high compensation amounts, we use a novel econometric approach that accommodates nonlinear utility of compensation for binary choice formats. We find strong evidence against convergent validity for both versions of the OE format. The DB format, especially in the theory-driven version, yields WTA estimates comparable in magnitude to those obtained in the SBC, both on average and when accounting for heterogeneity in preferences. These findings indicate that the OE format is not suitable for WTA elicitation, while a well-designed DB can yield WTA estimates comparable to those obtained using the SBC format.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实地实验比较了不同意愿接受（WTA） elicitation 格式的收敛效度，发现开放式（OE）格式不适用，而基于机制设计理论的双边界二分选择（DB）格式与单边界二分选择（SBC）基准格式的估计结果相当。
AI.research_question: 在实地环境中，不同的意愿接受（WTA） elicitation 格式（双边界二分选择DB和开放式OE）是否与单边界二分选择（SBC）基准格式具有收敛效度？
AI.motivation: 意愿接受（WTA）的准确估计对环境和能源政策评估至关重要，但不同 elicitation 格式的效度尚不明确。现有文献多在实验室环境中比较，缺乏实地证据。本研究与大型能源公司合作，在实地环境中检验标准版和理论驱动版DB及OE格式的收敛效度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论（mechanism-design theory），用于设计理论驱动的DB和OE格式；随机效用理论，用于建模二分选择数据中的非线性补偿效用。
AI.method: 实地实验，与一家大型能源公司合作，对受访者所在市镇安装陆上风电场所需补偿进行 elicitation。使用标准版和理论驱动版（基于机制设计理论）的DB和OE格式，以SBC为基准。采用新颖的计量经济学方法，在二分选择格式中容纳补偿的非线性效用。
AI.findings: （1）OE格式的两个版本均未通过收敛效度检验；（2）DB格式，特别是理论驱动版本，在平均水平和考虑偏好异质性时，得到的WTA估计值与SBC基准在量级上可比。
AI.theory_contributions: 为WTA elicitation格式的收敛效度提供了实地证据，验证了机制设计理论在改进DB格式中的应用效果，揭示了OE格式在WTA elicitation中的根本性缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境和能源政策制定者提供了WTA elicitation的实践指导：不应使用开放式格式，而应使用基于机制设计理论的双边界二分选择格式，以获得可靠的补偿估计。

title: Philosophical Reflections in Hausa Traditional Occupational Chieftaincies: An Analysis of Selected Proverbs
affiliations: Aminu Kano College of Islamic and Legal Studies and Federal University Gusau, Nigeria

detail.title: Philosophical Reflections in Hausa Traditional Occupational Chieftaincies: An Analysis of Selected Proverbs
detail.abstract: This study explores the traditional occupational titles among the Hausa people to uncover the deep thoughts and philosophies reflected in their cultural expressions, especially through proverbs. Proverbs serve as a key to understanding how the Hausa view authority, leadership, and the value of work within their traditional crafts and professions. The research is guided by Max Weber's (1922) Theory of Authority, which helps explain how power and respect are structured in these traditional roles. The study has two main goals: first, to collect proverbs tied to certain occupational titles, and second, to interpret the wisdom and philosophical ideas behind them. It also seeks to answer two major questions: (i) What kinds of proverbs are found in these traditional occupational titles? (ii) What philosophical insights or cultural meanings do these proverbs carry? Four traditional titles were selected for analysis: Sarkin Ɗori (Chief Bone Setters), Sarkin Fawa (Chief Butchers), Sarkin Gini (Chief Builders), and Sarkin Ƙira (Chief Blacksmiths). The findings reveal that each of these titles is enriched with proverbs that express the Hausa people's values, intelligence, and understanding of authority, labor, and tradition.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过收集和分析豪萨人传统职业头衔相关的谚语，运用韦伯的权威理论，揭示了豪萨文化中对权威、领导力和劳动价值的深层哲学思考。
AI.research_question: (i) 这些传统职业头衔中存在哪些类型的谚语？(ii) 这些谚语承载了哪些哲学见解或文化含义？
AI.motivation: 探索豪萨人传统职业头衔中蕴含的深层思想和哲学，尤其是通过谚语这一文化表达形式，理解豪萨人如何看待权威、领导力以及传统手工艺和职业中的劳动价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克斯·韦伯（1922）的权威理论（Theory of Authority），用于解释传统角色中权力和尊重的结构方式。
AI.method: 选取四个传统职业头衔（Sarkin Ɗori 首席接骨师、Sarkin Fawa 首席屠夫、Sarkin Gini 首席建筑工、Sarkin Ƙira 首席铁匠），收集与这些头衔相关的谚语并进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 每个传统头衔都富含谚语，这些谚语表达了豪萨人对权威、劳动和传统的价值观、智慧与理解。
AI.theory_contributions: 将韦伯权威理论应用于非洲本土文化语境，通过谚语这一民间智慧载体验证和丰富了理论在非西方社会中的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解豪萨传统职业文化中的权威结构与劳动伦理，为跨文化管理和传统职业传承提供文化洞察。

detail.abstract:
Italian Abstract: Il termine open banking si riferisce alla possibilità che terze parti accedano a dati e informazioni relativi ai conti correnti tenuti presso le banche dai clienti, con l’assenso di questi ultimi, al fine di fornire loro nuovi servizi e applicazioni. Il lavoro illustra le caratteristiche dell’open banking, il suo impatto sul mercato italiano dei pagamenti e le conseguenti modifiche nelle procedure di vigilanza e sorveglianza che regolano le relazioni dell’autorità finanziaria con i nuovi attori della catena dei pagamenti e assicurano il mantenimento nel tempo dell’equilibrio complessivo del sistema. Nel mercato italiano, a seguito dell’applicazione della normativa comunitaria stabilita nella Direttiva PSD2, le interfacce predisposte dai prestatori di servizi di pagamento per consentire l’accesso di terze parti fanno prevalentemente leva su soluzioni di sistema, infrastrutture tecniche che realizzano un unico punto di accesso per una pluralità di intermediari. L’Autorità nazionale competente, nelle sue funzioni di vigilanza e supervisione, ha sviluppato inoltre un sistema dei controlli che tengono conto delle nuove caratteristiche del mercato, fortemente innovative. L’attività di sorveglianza prevede inoltre la raccolta di dati statistici per il monitoraggio dei profili di efficienza, affidabilità, sicurezza e conformità delle soluzioni di sistema, consentendo l’elaborazione di indicatori utili per valutare l’evoluzione del mercato nazionale.
English Abstract: This paper describes the features of open banking, its impact on the Italian payments market, and the changes it has brought about in the supervisory and oversight procedures of Banca d'Italia, the competent financial authority, implemented to govern relations with the new players in the payment chain and to ensure that the overall stability of the payment system is maintained over time. In the Italian market, the application of EU regulations, set out in PSD2, led to the development of system solutions, based on hubs, to which payment service providers turned to a great extent to set up dedicated interfaces for third-party access. The national competent authority, in its supervisory and oversight functions, has set out system of controls, provided for by the regulations, to respond to the new and highly innovative characteristics of the market. The oversight activity also includes the collection of statistical data to monitor the efficiency, reliability, security and compliance profiles of the system solutions, enabling the development of useful indicators to assess the evolution of the national market.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了开放银行（open banking）对意大利支付市场的影响，以及意大利央行（Banca d'Italia）为应对这一变革而调整的监管与监督程序。在PSD2指令下，意大利市场主要采用基于枢纽（hub）的系统解决方案来实现第三方访问。监管机构建立了新的控制体系，并通过收集统计数据来监测系统解决方案的效率、可靠性、安全性和合规性。
AI.research_question: 开放银行如何影响意大利支付市场，以及意大利金融监管当局如何调整监督与监管程序以应对这一变化？
AI.motivation: 开放银行通过允许第三方访问客户银行账户数据来提供新服务，这对传统支付市场格局产生了深刻冲击，监管机构需要调整程序以维持系统稳定并规范新参与者的行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放银行（open banking）概念；欧盟PSD2指令框架；支付系统监管与监督理论；系统解决方案（枢纽基础设施）理论。
AI.method: 描述性分析：梳理开放银行的特征及其对意大利支付市场的影响，并结合意大利央行的监管实践，阐述监管程序的具体变化与数据收集方法。
AI.findings: 在意大利市场，PSD2指令下支付服务提供者主要采用基于枢纽的系统解决方案来构建第三方访问接口；意大利央行为此建立了新的控制体系，并通过收集统计数据分析系统解决方案的效率、可靠性、安全性和合规性，以监测市场演变。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了开放银行背景下支付市场监管与监督机制的理论探讨，展示了PSD2指令在具体国家市场中的落地实践。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管机构在开放银行时代调整监管框架提供了意大利的案例参考；为支付市场参与者理解系统解决方案（hub）的监管要求提供了实践指引。

title: ADR as a Pillar for Sustainable Electoral Governance and Peace in Africa
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: ADR as a Pillar for Sustainable Electoral Governance and Peace in Africa
detail.abstract: Electoral disputes in Africa transcend mere legal technicalities to encompass complex political, social, and psychological dynamics. While litigation upholds legal mandates, it operates within a rigid, adversarial framework that often fails to address the deep-seated relational and societal repercussions of contested polls. Regional and continental dispute resolution frameworks that integrate Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) provide essential avenues for dialogue, reconciliation, and conflict prevention that are both culturally grounded and politically sustainable. Drawing on extensive experience in electoral governance, mediation, psychological counseling, and peace advocacy, this paper argues that ADR-when formally institutionalized within both regional and domestic systems-can significantly enhance democratic consolidation and peace in Africa. By examining the roles of the African Union (AU), sub-regional bodies, and domestic electoral management institutions, this paper concludes that ADR is no longer a mere "alternative" but a governance imperative for the 21st-century African polity.

AI.tldr: 本文论证替代性争议解决机制（ADR）在非洲选举纠纷中已从"可选方案"转变为治理刚需，通过制度化嵌入区域和国内体系，能有效促进民主巩固与和平。
AI.research_question: 非洲选举纠纷中，替代性争议解决机制（ADR）如何通过制度化嵌入区域和国内体系，促进民主巩固与和平？
AI.motivation: 传统诉讼方式难以解决非洲选举冲突中深层次的社会关系和政治心理问题，需要探索更符合本土文化且政治可持续的争议解决路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 替代性争议解决（ADR）理论、选举治理理论、冲突预防与和解理论、民主巩固理论。
AI.method: 基于作者在选举治理、调解、心理咨询与和平倡导方面的丰富实践经验，结合对非盟、次区域组织及国内选举管理机构角色的分析。
AI.findings: ADR能提供对话、和解与冲突预防的关键渠道；当ADR正式制度化于区域和国内体系时，可显著增强非洲民主巩固与和平；ADR已成为21世纪非洲政体的治理 imperative。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ADR从"替代性"选项重新定义为"治理刚需"，拓展了选举争议解决的理论框架，强调制度嵌入对民主巩固的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲联盟、次区域组织和各国选举管理机构提供政策建议，推动ADR在选举治理中的正式制度化，促进文化适切的冲突解决机制落地。

title:
The Challenge of School Efficiency;
 A Comparative Analysis of Public and Private Schools in Italy  with a Focus on Socioemotional Skills
affiliations: Politecnico di Milano - Department of Management, Economics and Industrial Engineering and Polytechnic University of Milan

detail.title:
The Challenge of School Efficiency;
 A Comparative Analysis of Public and Private Schools in Italy  with a Focus on Socioemotional Skills
detail.abstract: This paper explores the relative efficiency of Italian public vs private schools using data from different waves of the OECD PISA (2015, 2018 and 2022). A bootstrap data envelopment analysis is used as the methodological approach. For the first time in the relevant literature, variables measuring socioemotional skills (SESs) are included to measure efficiency. Overall, the findings show that Italian schools can increase their output by around 15% (private) or 20% (public), using the same available resources. Private schools are more efficient than their public counterparts, and they are also more productive in developing SESs.

AI.tldr: 本文利用OECD PISA 2015、2018和2022年数据，通过Bootstrap数据包络分析，首次纳入社会情感技能变量，比较意大利公立与私立学校的相对效率。结果发现私立学校效率更高，且在社会情感技能培养方面更具优势。
AI.research_question: 意大利公立学校与私立学校的相对效率如何？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏对社会情感技能在教育效率评估中的考量，本文首次将社会情感技能纳入效率分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育生产函数理论、Bootstrap数据包络分析方法
AI.method: 采用Bootstrap数据包络分析（DEA），基于OECD PISA 2015、2018和2022年三轮数据进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 意大利学校在现有资源下仍可提升产出约15%（私立）或20%（公立）；私立学校整体效率更高，且在社会情感技能培养上更具生产力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将社会情感技能变量纳入教育效率评估框架，拓展了教育生产函数理论的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为意大利教育政策制定者优化资源配置、提升学校效率提供实证依据；提示公立学校需关注社会情感技能培养。

title: Stage-Coupled Computational Framework for Stratified Accessibility and Equity Analysis in Community-Based Elderly Care Services
affiliations: University of Southern California

detail.title: Stage-Coupled Computational Framework for Stratified Accessibility and Equity Analysis in Community-Based Elderly Care Services

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All data used in this study were anonymized before analysis. No personally identifiable information was included. The study was conducted in accordance with ethical standards for research involving human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: As the supply network for community-based elderly care services expands, the research focus shifts from mere service availability to computationally modeling who can access and utilize services effectively. Existing studies often consider accessibility as spatial distance or economic cost and equity as simple resource allocation, limiting insights into cumulative disadvantages faced by older adults with low income, digital barriers, or limited family support. Based on data from 3,800 community elder care sites across 20 U.S. metropolitan areas, individual survey data from 6,240 older adults, and community socioeconomic indicators, this study constructs a computational five-stage accessibility chain model: "Information Accessibility-Eligibility Determination-Process Accessibility-Service Availability-Outcome Attainability."The study integrates heterogeneous data encoding, adaptive spatial accessibility computation, stage-aware vulnerability representation, and hierarchical modeling. Two-Step Floating Contour Analysis (2SFCA), stage-coupled logit modeling, and deep embedded clustering are applied to stratify risk and optimize service access prediction. A cross-vulnerability index, combining six factors-age, income, cognition, language proficiency, family support, and digital access-is incorporated into the model to quantify cumulative impacts across stages.Preliminary results indicate that inequalities do not primarily arise from geographic proximity but accumulate during intermediate phases of information identification, eligibility determination, and process navigation. Digital vulnerability and lack of family support remain major limiting factors even after controlling for spatial accessibility, demonstrating the effectiveness of stage-aware, computationally optimized modeling. This paper proposes an integrated "accessibility chain-intersectional vulnerability" computational framework, advancing service equity from outcome equity to process and transformational equity, and providing a technology-driven foundation for targeted service allocation, navigation system optimization, and identification of high-risk groups in community-based elderly care.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了基于计算模型的社区养老"可达性链"框架，发现老年人服务不平等主要源于信息获取、资格认定和流程导航等中间环节的累积劣势，而非单纯的地理距离，提出了"可达性链-交叉脆弱性"整合计算框架。
AI.research_question: 在社区养老服务体系扩展的背景下，如何通过计算建模量化老年人多重脆弱性（低收入、数字障碍、家庭支持不足等）在服务获取各阶段产生的累积不平等效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将可达性视为空间距离或经济成本、公平视为简单资源分配，无法揭示低收���、数字障碍或家庭支持不足的老年人在服务获取中面临的累积劣势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 五阶段可达性链模型（信息可达性→资格确定→流程可达性→服务可用性→结果可及性）；交叉脆弱性理论（年龄、收入、认知、语言能力、家庭支持、数字接入六因素）；过程公平与转化公平理论。
AI.method: 异构数据编码；自适应空间可达性计算（两步浮动流域分析2SFCA）；阶段耦合Logit建模；深度嵌入聚类（Deep Embedded Clustering）进行风险分层与服务获取预测；交叉脆弱性指数构建。
AI.findings: 不平等主要来源于信息识别、资格确定和流程导航等中间阶段的累积效应，而非地理可达性；在控制空间可达性后，数字脆弱性和家庭支持不足仍是主要限制因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"可达性链-交叉脆弱性"整合计算框架，将服务公平从结果公平拓展至过程公平和转化公平；为社区养老领域提供了可计算的多阶段累积不平等分析范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务精准配置、导航系统优化和高风险群体识别提供技术驱动的基础；支持针对不同脆弱性阶段的目标化干预策略设计。

title: Employment Effects of the Inflation Reduction Act

detail.title: Employment Effects of the Inflation Reduction Act

declarations.funderStatement: This work benefited from the support of the NSF Graduate Research Fellowship and the George and Obie Shultz Fund.

detail.abstract: One of the key justifications for the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) was its potential to create jobs. I examine the short-run employment effects of the IRA's clean electricity tax credits using industry-by-county data from the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages. I implement a synthetic difference-indifferences design, comparing counties with high propensity for solar and battery development to those without, based on irradiance and transmission capacity. By 2025Q2, employment increased by nearly 100 jobs per county in directly-related construction industries (an 18% increase relative to the pre-IRA mean), with spillovers of approximately 90 jobs per county in related construction industries (a 17% increase). These gains amount to an increase of 190,000 jobs, or 2.2 jobs per MW of new solar and battery storage capacity. Local gains were concentrated in populous counties whose residents were more likely to support climate policy, limiting the scope for the law's tax credits to build new political constituencies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用季度就业与工资普查数据，采用合成双重差分法，研究发现《通胀削减法案》的清洁电力税收抵免在短期内显著增加了太阳能和电池相关产业的就业，每县增加约190个岗位，总量达19万个就业岗位，但就业增长集中在已支持气候政策的人口稠密县，限制了法案通过税收抵免扩大政治支持基础的作用。
AI.research_question: 《通胀削减法案》（IRA）的清洁电力税收抵免在短期内的就业效应如何？这些就业增长是否有助于为气候政策建立新的政治支持基础？
AI.motivation: IRA的核心论证之一是它能创造就业，但缺乏对短期就业效果的实证评估；同时，理解绿色政策能否通过创造就业来扩大政治支持基础，对于气候政策的政治经济可持续性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 就业创造理论、政治经济学的利益相关者理论、政策反馈理论（政策创造政治选区）
AI.method: 利用季度就业与工资普查（QCEW）的行业-县层面数据，基于太阳辐照度和输电容量构建县一级的太阳能和电池发展潜力指标，采用合成双重差分法（synthetic difference-in-differences）进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 到2025年第二季度，高潜力县在直接相关的建筑行业每县增加近100个就业岗位（较IRA前均值增长18%），在相关建筑行业产生约90个岗位的溢出效应（增长17%）；总计增加19万个就业岗位，相当于每新增1兆瓦太阳能和电池储能容量创造2.2个岗位。但这些就业增长集中在人口稠密且居民原本就更支持气候政策的县，限制了税收抵免通过创造就业来扩大气候政策政治支持基础的空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政策反馈理论提供了实证证据，揭示了绿色就业创造在改变政治格局方面可能存在的局限性；丰富了关于环境政策政治经济学的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了IRA短期就业效应的量化评估，提示仅靠绿色就业创造难以有效扩大气候政策的政治支持基础，需要辅以其他政策工具来构建新的政治选区。

title:
Transforming African Public Debt into Productive Concessionary Assets 
The African Debt-for-Development Concession (ADDC) Framework

detail.title:
Transforming African Public Debt into Productive Concessionary Assets 
The African Debt-for-Development Concession (ADDC) Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is conceptual and methodological. It does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, interviews, surveys, experiments, or case-study subjects requiring informed consent. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The paper was prepared independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This public working paper develops a conceptual and quantitative framework for transforming a portion of African public debt into productive concessionary assets through an instrument called the African Debt-for-Development Concession, abbreviated as ADDC. The paper starts from a historical problem: public debt has expanded globally and in Africa, but many borrowing cycles have not produced a sufficient stock of self-liquidating productive assets. Conventional restructuring, refinancing and relief can reduce liquidity pressure, yet they do not automatically create ports, logistics corridors, energy platforms, industrial zones, digital infrastructure or export capacity. ADDC therefore reframes part of the debt question as a conversion problem: under what conditions can a sovereign claim be reorganised into economic rights linked to a governed productive asset? The paper integrates debt-for-development swaps, sovereign recovery analysis, public-private partnerships, concession governance, special economic zones and institutional economics. Its main contribution is a dual-sided public model: a debtor eligibility logic, a creditor attractiveness logic and a joint viability rule. The public version keeps the equations general and the stress tests stylised. It is intended as an academic screening framework, not as a complete transaction manual.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"非洲债务换发展特许权"（ADDC）这一概念与定量框架，旨在将非洲部分公共债务转化为生产性特许资产，解决历史性债务循环未能创造足够自偿性生产资产的问题。
AI.research_question: 在何种条件下，主权债权可以被重组为与受治理生产性资产相关的经济权利？
AI.motivation: 全球及非洲公共债务扩张，但许多借贷周期未能产生足够的自偿性生产资产；传统的债务重组、再融资和减免虽能缓解流动性压力，却不能自动创造港口、物流走廊、能源平台、工业区、数字基础设施或出口能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融合了债务换发展互换、主权回收分析、公私合作伙伴关系、特许权治理、经济特区和制度经济学等理论。
AI.method: 构建双面公共模型：债务人资格逻辑、债权人吸引力逻辑和联合可行性规则；方程保持一般化，压力测试为程式化形式。
AI.findings: 提出了ADDC框架，作为学术筛选工具而非完整交易手册，可将部分债务问题重新定义为转换问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合多个理论领域，为债务转换提供了系统的学术筛选框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲债务重构提供了从"减免"转向"资产转换"的新思路，可能帮助非洲国家将债务转化为实际生产性基础设施。

title: Macroeconomic Determinants of Corruption: An Empirical Analysis of Eastern European Countries
affiliations: International Hellenic University, International Hellenic University and

detail.title: Macroeconomic Determinants of Corruption: An Empirical Analysis of Eastern European Countries
detail.abstract: Corruption is a complex issue that undermines institutional integrity, distorts economic incentives and significantly contributes to disparities in economic development and inequality. The phenomenon is influenced by a range of factors and we examine the impact of key macroeconomic determinants identified in the literature as likely drivers of corruption dynamics in open economies. Our analysis of panel data from Eastern European countries (Panel Fully Modified Least Squares) reveals that, in the long run, economic freedom, government expenditure on education, inward foreign direct investment (FDI), and government effectiveness are associated with decreased perceptions of public sector corruption. The findings provide a comprehensive understanding of the macroeconomic drivers of corruption and propose policy recommendations to mitigate its adverse effects on economic growth and equity.

AI.tldr: 本文使用东欧国家面板数据，研究发现经济自由、教育支出、外商直接投资和政府效能与降低公共部门腐败感知度显著相关。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济因素如何影响开放经济体中的腐败动态？
AI.motivation: 腐败破坏制度完整性、扭曲经济激励并加剧不平等，需要系统理解其宏观经济驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于腐败的经济学理论，分析宏观经济因素（经济自由、教育支出、FDI、政府效能）对腐败的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用面板完全修正最小二乘法（Panel FMOLS）分析东欧国家面板数据。
AI.findings: 长期来看，经济自由、政府教育支出、外商直接投资和政府效能与腐败感知度下降显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了开放经济中腐败宏观经济驱动因素的综合实证证据，丰富了腐败决定因素的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了通过提升经济自由、增加教育投入、吸引外资和改善政府效能来减轻腐败对经济增长和公平负面影响的政策建议。

title: Skill, Chance, and the Constitutional Reckoning at the India's Online Gaming Tax War
affiliations: OP Jindal Global University, Jindal Global Law School (JGLS)

detail.title: Skill, Chance, and the Constitutional Reckoning at the India's Online Gaming Tax War
detail.abstract: The Bengaluru-based company operates an online rummy platform which received a tax demand of ₹21,000 crore for unpaid GST. The figure was staggering, the largest single tax demand in the history of the Indian Republic. The case exceeded normal boundaries because its essential legal foundation established rummy as a gambling activity despite the Supreme Court's 1968 decision that recognized rummy as a skill-based game. 1 Within months, similar demands had been served on Dream11, MPL, A23 Games, PokerBaazi, Junglee Rummy, and dozens of other platforms. The total demands surpassed ₹1.5 lakh crore. Several startups contemplated relocating offshore. The digital entertainment industry in India, which has the fastest expansion rate, generates annual revenues over ₹16,000 crore and experiences a 27% annual growth rate, faced a tax obligation that surpassed their total profits since they started operations. The Gameskraft controversy, according to this paper, represents a different story because it does not involve video games as its main focus. The story shows how an administration that seeks more revenue treats a constitutional boundary as a minor financial problem which they can solve through forceful policing and new law changes. The upcoming Supreme Court judgment which the court will announce after its 8 August 2025 proceedings will determine both tax regulations for a particular industry and the level of legal authority that Indian authorities must show toward their established legal principles.

AI.tldr: 本文以Gameskraft公司收到2.1万亿卢比GST税单事件为切入点，揭示了印度政府如何通过税收手段将宪法对"技能游戏"的保护边界视为可随意突破的财务问题，展现了行政权力对法律原则的侵蚀。
AI.research_question: 印度政府如何通过税收执法和立法手段突破宪法对技能游戏（rummy）的保护边界？这一事件对法治原则和数字娱乐产业有何影响？
AI.motivation: Gameskraft案是印度历史上最大单笔税收要求（2.1万亿卢比），且涉及最高法院1968年已明确认定rummy为技能游戏的宪法判例，但税务机关却将其重新定性为赌博。这一矛盾揭示了行政权力与法治原则之间的深层张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收权力与宪法边界的关系、行政国家对法治原则的侵蚀、核心vs外围活动（游戏vs税收）的分析框架
AI.method: 案例研究法，以Gameskraft事件为核心案例，辅以对Dream11、MPL等多家平台的税务追缴情况及行业整体数据的分析
AI.findings: 1）印度税务机关将最高法院已认定为技能游戏的rummy重新定性为赌博以征收高额GST；2）多家平台收到类似税单，总金额超15万亿卢比；3）税收金额远超行业自成立以来的总利润；4）部分初创企业考虑迁往海外；5）案件本质不是关于游戏，而是关于政府如何将宪法边界视为财务问题并通过强力执法和修法解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了税收权力如何被用作突破宪法保护边界的工具，丰富了关于行政权力与法治原则冲突的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出印度最高法院2025年8月8日的判决将决定：不仅是一个行业的税收政策，更是印度行政机关对既有法律原则应保持多大尊重的问题。为数字娱乐产业的政策风险防范提供了重要警示。

title: Valuations under Tradeoff Complexity
affiliations: Harvard University and Harvard University Department of Economics

detail.title: Valuations under Tradeoff Complexity
detail.abstract: Valuation tasks are a workhorse method for testing theories of individual preferences. However, a body of evidence suggests that complexity produces systematic measurement error in valuations, which raises the question of how researchers should interpret and utilize valuation data. To formally study this issue, we develop a model of complexity-driven noise in the valuation of risky prospects, in which the difficulty of comparing options to prices produces systematic noise in their valuations. We show how this model of noise can explain a number of documented valuation patterns that are difficult to rationalize under prevailing theories of risk preferences, as well as novel experimental evidence of systematic inconsistencies across valuation formats. We then characterize which valuation-based tests of preferences are robust to complexity in our model. While complexity distorts the levels of valuations in our model, differences between valuations can be informative, so long as complexity is held fixed across valuation tasks. We provide a formal criterion for robustness and apply it to valuation designs in the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个复杂噪声估值模型，研究复杂度如何导致风险资产估值中的系统性测量误差，并证明在复杂度保持不变的情况下，估值差异仍可提供信息。
AI.research_question: 研究者应如何解释和利用受复杂度影响的估值数据？哪些基于估值的偏好检验对复杂度具有稳健性？
AI.motivation: 已有证据表明复杂度会导致估值中的系统性测量误差，这引发了如何正确解释和利用估值数据的疑问。传统风险偏好理论难以解释许多已记录的估值模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂度驱动的噪声模型：将选项与价格进行比较的难度会在估值中产生系统性噪声。
AI.method: 理论建模，辅以新颖的实验证据，证明不同估值格式之间存在系统性不一致。
AI.findings: 复杂度会扭曲估值的绝对水平，但只要复杂度在不同估值任务间保持不变，估值差异仍可提供信息。论文提供了稳健性的形式化标准，并将其应用于文献中的估值设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个正式模型来解释现有风险偏好理论难以解释的估值模式；为基于估值的偏好检验提供了稳健性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者如何正确设计和解释估值实验提供了指导：在保持复杂度恒定的条件下，估值差异是可靠的推断工具。

title: A Temporally Adaptive Conditional Estimator (TACE) for Cluster-Weighted Conditional Probability with a Permutation-Based Cascade-Detection Test

detail.title: A Temporally Adaptive Conditional Estimator (TACE) for Cluster-Weighted Conditional Probability with a Permutation-Based Cascade-Detection Test

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that have influenced, or could be perceived to have influenced, this study. The author is an independent researcher with no institutional affiliation, no funding source for this work, and no commercial interest in the methods or applications described. The FDIC Failed Bank List used in the applied analysis is a publicly available regulatory dataset.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves no human or animal subjects. The analysis uses only publicly available aggregated regulatory data (the FDIC Failed Bank List).
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research. The author is an independent researcher and conducted this work without financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency.

detail.abstract: Tightly coupled systems—financial networks, power grids, epidemic transmission chains—exhibit cascade dynamics in which events occurring in rapid temporal succession show elevated conditional dependence relative to isolated events. Classical empirical conditional probability estimation weights all observations satisfying the conditioning event equally and therefore aggregates cascade-period and quiescent-period observations into a single marginal estimate. We define the cluster-weighted conditional probability p_cluster—the conditional probability of the outcome among observations embedded in dense local activity—as a distinct estimand from the marginal P(A|B), and introduce the Temporally Adaptive Conditional Estimator (TACE) for it. The weighting kernel is derived from a minimal set of axioms with two explicit parametric specifications. We develop a permutation-based test of the null hypothesis H0: p_cluster = P(A|B), demonstrate its calibration via simulation (Type-I error 0.054 at nominal alpha = 0.05 over 2,000 null datasets), and characterize its power as a function of cascade strength and sample size. We propose K-fold cross-validation by held-out predictive log-likelihood for selection of the two tuning parameters. An applied analysis using the complete record of 573 FDIC bank failures from October 2000 through January 2026 yields P_hat_t - P_hat = +0.083 (p = 0.001) for a regional-contagion outcome, with null behavior on non-cascade-coupled discriminant controls. A scan-statistic comparator (Kulldorff 1997) detects the same cascade structure but does not provide the magnitude and directional signal that TACE produces. The estimator is positioned as a complement to classical conditional probability estimation and to existing cascade-detection methods: their joint use yields both the long-run marginal probability and a quantitative, interpretable signal of cluster-induced conditional dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为TACE（时间自适应条件估计量）的新统计方法，用于估计密集局部活动（即“集群”）中的条件概率p_cluster，以区别于传统的边际条件概率P(A|B)。通过最小化公理推导核函数、置换检验验证零假设、以及使用FDIC银行破产数据进行实证分析，TACE能捕捉并量化级联动态中的条件依赖性，为金融网络等紧耦合系统的风险分析提供补充工具。
AI.research_question: 如何从经验数据中估计紧耦合系统（如金融网络、电力网络）在级联动态期（密集局部活动）的条件概率，并检验其与长期边际条件概率是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 经典的条件概率估计将级联期和平静期的观测同等加权，得到一个单一的边际估计，无法区分密集局部活动（集群）中的条件依赖性。然而在紧耦合系统中，级联事件往往呈现更高的条件依赖性，因此需要一个专门估计“集群条件概率”的方法，以捕捉这种差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: ①级联动力学（cascade dynamics）：紧耦合系统中事件在快速时间序列中呈现增强的条件依赖性；②条件概率与集群条件概率的区分：p_cluster与边际P(A|B)作为不同的估计对象；③自适应核加权方法：基于最小公理导出的时间加权函数；④置换检验：用于检验H0: p_cluster = P(A|B)。
AI.method: ①提出TACE估计量，通过时间核函数对观测加权，核函数基于最小公理推导，并给出两种参数化形式；②使用置换检验检验零假设H0: p_cluster = P(A|B)；③通过模拟评估校准性（2000个零数据集下类型I错误率为0.054，名义α=0.05）和检验功效；④采用K折交叉验证（基于留出预测对数似然）选择两个调优参数；⑤应用分析：使用2000年10月至2026年1月FDIC 573起银行破产数据，检验区域传染结果；⑥与Kulldorff（1997）的扫描统计量进行比较。
AI.findings: ①在2000个零数据集下，置换检验的类型I错误率为0.054，接近名义α=0.05，说明检验校准良好；②实证分析中，FDIC银行破产数据中区域传染结果的P̂_t - P̂ = +0.083（p=0.001），表明集群条件概率显著高于边际条件概率，而非级联耦合的判别控制变量则呈现零行为；③与Kulldorff扫描统计量相比，TACE不仅能检测级联结构，还能提供量化和方向信号（正向或负向偏差）。
AI.theory_contributions: ①明确定义了p_cluster（集群条件概率）作为与边际条件概率P(A|B)不同的估计目标，填补了级联动力学中条件概率估计的理论空白；②提出基于公理推导的时间加权核函数，为自适应条件估计提供理论基础；③构建了置换检验框架，用于检验集群条件概率与边际条件概率的显著差异；④将TACE定位为经典条件概率估计和现有级联检测方法的互补工具，形成联合使用范式。
AI.practical_contributions: ①提供了一种可定量、可解释的方法来捕捉级联动态中的条件依赖性强度与方向，适用于金融网络、电力网络、疫情传播链等紧耦合系统；②在金融监管中，FDIC银行破产数据的应用表明TACE可用于早期识别区域传染风险，比传统扫描统计量提供更多信息；③通过交叉验证选择调优参数，增强了方法的实际可用性和稳健性。

title:
The Fate Mechanism:
Jung's Clinical Observation, Libet's Experimental Confirmation, and the Neuroscientific Case for a Timed Interception Window

detail.title:
The Fate Mechanism:
Jung's Clinical Observation, Libet's Experimental Confirmation, and the Neuroscientific Case for a Timed Interception Window

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No funding was received for this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This was not a study with patients/participants.
declarations.funderStatement: Future State, LLC is the authoring institution, there are no grants, no institutional affiliations with competing interests, no pharmaceutical or industry relationships, and no financial interests in the constructs or interventions described.

detail.abstract:
Carl Jung's clinical observation — that when an inner situation is not made conscious, it happens outside as fate — has circulated for nearly a century without systematic engagement from behavioral neuroscience. What Jung actually wrote, in Aion (1951, CW 9ii, Para 126), is more precise than the widely circulated paraphrase: "The psychological rule says that when an inner situation is not made conscious, it happens outside, as fate." This paper argues that this authentic proposition finds convergent structural support across four independent research streams developed without reference to each other or to Jung.

The four streams are: Libet's readiness potential experiments (1983), which found that neural precursors of voluntary movement precede reported conscious awareness of intention by an average of 335 milliseconds; LeDoux's dual-pathway threat architecture (1996–2017), which established that subcortical threat-detection circuits can initiate early physiological responses below any threshold of conscious awareness, setting a trajectory toward behavioral expression before cortical processing is complete; Barrett's Theory of Constructed Emotion (2017), which proposes that emotional experience is a predictive construction assembled from prior experience encoded below the level of language, presented to consciousness as unmediated fact; and the Fear Response Gap framework (Anderson, 2021–2026), a practice-derived observational framework independently consistent with these streams, which has theoretically specified a window of approximately 2 to 5 seconds following subcortical cascade initiation as the interval within which conscious somatic intervention may be structurally possible.

Together these streams constitute converging structural support for a mechanistic interpretation of Jung's proposition: the nervous system initiates and justifies behavior through processes the actor cannot access, and the actor encounters the result as fate. The LeDoux-Barrett architecture does not merely provide analogs for Jung's description of the problem — it suggests a specification for the solution. The theoretically derived interception window is proposed as the operational definition of Jung's prescription to make the unconscious conscious: a trainable, neurobiologically grounded interval during which the predictive cascade that would otherwise produce automatic behavioral output may be interruptable through practiced somatic engagement.

Access to the window is proposed to be a dynamic function of body budget status — shaped by relational, developmental, nutritional, and historical conditions — with direct implications for why insight-based therapeutic approaches consistently underperform in populations experiencing cumulative adversity. An additional convergent line is drawn to the Tlingit Shaman's Trail framework, whose practices are structurally consonant with the proposed architecture and constitute a fifth independent observational tradition that appears to have arrived at analogous structural solutions through a completely different epistemological pathway. This paper is a theoretical synthesis and hypothesis-generating framework, not an empirical confirmation paper. Limitations and a four-priority empirical research agenda are specified.

title: AI-Generated and AI-Assisted Code Under EU Law: Intellectual Property and Compliance Challenges

detail.title: AI-Generated and AI-Assisted Code Under EU Law: Intellectual Property and Compliance Challenges
detail.abstract: This is a legal analysis of the current legal framework across European Union regarding the protection of software programs in the context of generating code using AI systems. Given how rapidly and fundamentally software development has changed, the new technologies raise the question whether the existing legal framework for protection of computer programs is still adequate to address these new challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟现行法律框架对AI生成代码场景下软件程序的保护是否仍然充分，指出随着软件开发方式的根本性变化，现有法律面临新的挑战。
AI.research_question: 在AI系统生成代码的背景下，欧盟现行软件程序保护法律框架是否仍然充分？
AI.motivation: 软件开发方式发生了快速且根本性的变化，AI生成代码技术引发了对现有法律框架适应性的质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟软件保护法律框架（如《计算机程序法律保护指令》等相关法规）的理论基础。
AI.method: 法律分析（Legal Analysis），对欧盟现行法律框架进行规范性审查。
AI.findings: AI生成代码技术对现有软件保护法律框架提出了新的挑战，现有法律在应对这些新问题时可能存在不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI生成代码情境下软件保护法律理论面临的适用性困境，为法律理论的更新提供了分析基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟立法者和司法实践提供了关于如何调整或解释现有法律以应对AI代码生成挑战的参考建议。

title: Who Bears Oil Price Risk? Fuel-Pricing Rules, Policy Uncertainty, and Sovereign Risk
affiliations: University of Sao Paulo (USP), Faculty of Economics, Administration and Accounting (FEA), Department of Administration, Students, Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Sao Paulo School of Business Administration and SOAS University of London

detail.title: Who Bears Oil Price Risk? Fuel-Pricing Rules, Policy Uncertainty, and Sovereign Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none

detail.abstract: How do policy rules shape the macroeconomic transmission of commodity-price shocks? We study Brazil's October 2016 shift from administered fuel pricing to import-parity pricing as a discrete institutional change that reallocated oil-price risk away from the sovereign balance sheet. We find that rule-based pricing reduced the amplification of oil shocks through sovereign risk premia and lowered exchange-rate volatility, despite increasing domestic pass-through from global oil prices. The fuel price-sovereign spread relationship changes sharply across regimes: under administered pricing, higher oil prices lower spreads through a commodity-windfall channel, whereas under import-parity pricing the same shock raises spreads on impact as inflationary pressures shift risk onto households and firms. At longer horizons, however, sovereign-risk responses under import-parity pricing weaken and become negative, consistent with lower contingent fiscal exposure and reduced policy uncertainty. Placebo tests, structural breaks, and fuel-versus-nonfuel comparisons support a credibility-based interpretation in which predictable pricing rules limit discretionary intervention and dampen risk-premium amplification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究巴西2016年从行政定价转向进口平价定价的燃料政策改革，发现基于规则的定价降低了主权风险溢价对油价冲击的放大效应，减少了汇率波动，尽管增加了国内油价传导。可信的定价规则通过限制自由裁量干预削弱了风险溢价放大机制。
AI.research_question: 政策规则如何影响大宗商品价格冲击的宏观经济传导机制？
AI.motivation: 理解政策制度设计（行政定价 vs. 规则定价）如何改变主权风险、汇率和通胀对油价冲击的动态响应，为资源依赖型经济体提供政策设计依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权风险溢价渠道、可信承诺理论、政策不确定性视角、风险分配机制
AI.method: 准自然实验（巴西2016年政策改革），结合事件研究、结构断点检验、安慰剂检验、燃料与非燃料部门比较分析
AI.findings: 规则定价降低了主权风险溢价对油价冲击的放大效应和汇率波动；行政定价下油价上升通过商品意外收益渠道降低利差，进口平价下则因通胀压力推高利差；长期来看进口平价下主权风险响应转负，源于或有财政风险降低和政策不确定性下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策规则通过"可信承诺"渠道影响风险溢价放大的微观机制，拓展了主权风险与大宗商品价格冲击关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资源依赖型经济体提供政策设计启示：可预测的规则定价有助于降低宏观经济脆弱性，即便在短期内增加通胀传导。

title: The Future Orientation of Languages and Stock Price Timeliness: International Evidence
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics, University of Sussex Business School,  and Nottingham University Business School China

detail.title: The Future Orientation of Languages and Stock Price Timeliness: International Evidence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors report there are no competing interests to declare.

detail.abstract: Strong future time reference (FTR) languages grammatically mark the future, prompting speakers to mentally separate future events from the present. Using 183,797 firm-year observations collected from 47 countries between 1992 and 2022, we examine the relationship between language FTR and intra-year price discovery. We find that the use of strong-FTR languages is associated with slower incorporation of earnings-relevant information into share prices. The effect is more pronounced for firms with lower analyst coverage and weaker corporate governance. Our findings, which remain robust across extensive sensitivity analyses, have important implications for investors and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 研究语言未来时态标记（FTR）与股价年内价格发现速度的关系，发现强FTR语言使用者的国家，其企业盈余信息融入股价的速度更慢。
AI.research_question: 语言未来时态标记（FTR）如何影响企业盈余信息在股价中的年内价格发现速度？
AI.motivation: 强FTR语言在语法上强制区分现在与未来，可能导致说话者心理上将未来事件与当下分离，从而影响对未来信息的处理与定价效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语言相对论（萨丕尔-沃尔夫假说）、时间认知理论、市场效率理论
AI.method: 基于47个国家1992-2022年183,797个公司-年度观测值，采用跨国回归分析检验语言FTR强度与价格发现速度的关系。
AI.findings: 强FTR语言使用与盈余信息融入股价速度呈负相关；该效应在分析师覆盖度低、公司治理弱的企业中更为显著；结果在多种敏感性分析中保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 将语言特征纳入资本市场信息效率的研究框架，拓展了语言相对论在金融领域的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒投资者和政策制定者关注语言特征对市场信息效率的潜在影响，为跨境投资和监管决策提供新视角。

title: The CSLT: Unifying U.S. Cross-Border Securities Holdings and Transactions Data
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, , Independent, Independent, Independent, Independent, Independent, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Independent

detail.title: The CSLT: Unifying U.S. Cross-Border Securities Holdings and Transactions Data

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: The Treasury International Capital (TIC) system offers comprehensive data on U.S. cross-border securities holdings and transactions, facilitating a detailed understanding of U.S. capital flows. For users new to TIC data, a key fact shapes how to use these statistics: holdings data have been collected for a longer historical period and are measured with greater precision than transactions data.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了美国财政部国际资本（TIC）系统提供的美国跨境证券持有和交易数据，强调持有数据比交易数据具有更长的历史记录和更高的精确度，为新手用户提供了使用这些统计数据的核心要点。
AI.research_question: 如何理解和使用TIC数据系统中的美国跨境证券持有数据与交易数据？
AI.motivation: 帮助TIC数据的新手用户了解持有数据与交易数据的关键差异，以便正确使用这些统计数据。

detail.abstract:
Background. Human-AI interaction has moved from a human-computer interaction research topic to an operational and regulatory concern. The April 2025 rollback of an OpenAI model update after the system became, in the company's own characterisation, overly flattering or agreeable, the March 2026 Science publication demonstrating that sycophantic AI reduces prosocial intentions and promotes dependence, and the August 2026 implementation deadline for European Union AI Act Article 14 human oversight requirements have placed appropriate reliance, calibrated trust, and meaningful oversight at the centre of practitioner and regulatory attention. The literature, however, remains fragmented across disciplines, modalities, and jurisdictions.

Purpose. This paper provides a comprehensive synthesis of human-AI interaction research and practice across three contemporary AI modalities, predictive, generative, and agentic, and integrates this synthesis with the regulatory architectures emerging in the European Union and the Gulf Cooperation Council. The paper is designed as a reference contribution for the wider fifteen-paper slate and as a scholar-practitioner resource for senior cybersecurity, governance, and risk audiences.

Approach. The paper adopts a narrative review methodology combining contemporary 2024 to 2026 empirical literature on trust calibration, appropriate reliance, and oversight effectiveness; primary regulatory document analysis (the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, UAE Information Assurance Standards, UAE Personal Data Protection Law, the UAE Charter for the Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence, and Saudi Arabian regulatory instruments); and analysis of recent documented incidents including the OpenAI sycophancy rollback and the body of academic work on emergent sycophancy in large language models.

Findings. Three observations emerge from the synthesis. First, the constructs of trust, calibration, and reliance, while conceptually distinct, are increasingly conflated in practitioner discourse; appropriate reliance, the behavioural outcome that practitioner and regulatory frameworks ultimately require, is empirically distinguishable from trust as an attitude and warrants separate measurement. Second, the modality-specific risk profiles differ substantially: predictive AI risks are concentrated in confidence miscalibration and rubber-stamp oversight; generative AI risks are concentrated in sycophancy and anthropomorphic trust manipulation; agentic AI risks are concentrated in oversight tractability as system autonomy increases. Third, the EU AI Act Article 14 oversight architecture is more developed than its GCC counterparts, but GCC regulatory instruments include user awareness, transparency, and cultural appropriateness considerations that EU instruments under-address; cultural bias documented in large language models toward Western entities creates a trust calibration problem in Arabic-speaking user populations that has a limited counterpart in EU deployment contexts.

Implications. Practitioners deploying AI systems across modalities should distinguish trust, calibration, and reliance in their human factors design and assessment. Multi-jurisdictional deployments in the GCC require interaction design that accommodates both EU AI Act oversight obligations and GCC-specific cultural, linguistic, and regulatory expectations. Empirical validation through practitioner vignette surveys is reserved for subsequent research in this slate. Future work will extend the analysis through comparative regulatory mapping (Paper 14) and the assessment of dual-use interaction risks (Paper 12).

AI.tldr: 本文综合分析了2024-2026年间预测性、生成性和代理性三种AI模态下的人机交互研究，整合了欧盟与海湾合作委员会的监管架构，发现信任校准、适当依赖和有效监督这三个概念在实务中常被混淆，且不同模态的AI风险特征存在显著差异，同时揭示了现有监管框架中的文化偏误问题。
AI.research_question: 在预测性、生成性和代理性三种当代AI模态下，人机交互中的信任校准、适当依赖和有效监督存在怎样的概念关系、风险差异和监管框架差异？
AI.motivation: 2025年OpenAI模型因过度讨好被回滚、2026年Science发表谄媚型AI减少亲社会意图的研究，以及EU AI Act第14条人类监督要求的实施截止日期，使适当依赖、校准信任和有意义监督成为实践和监管的核心关切，但相关文献在学科、模态和司法管辖区之间呈碎片化状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任校准理论、适当依赖理论、人机交互中的监督有效性理论，以及跨文化信任研究。
AI.method: 叙事综述方法，结合2024-2026年实证文献、主要监管文件分析（EU AI Act、ISO/IEC 42001、NIST AI风险管理框架、阿联酋和沙特监管文书）以及近期事件分析（OpenAI谄媚回滚、大语言模型谄媚研究）。
AI.findings: 第一，信任、校准和依赖三个概念在实务中被混淆，适当依赖作为行为结果应与作为态度的信任分开测量；第二，预测性AI风险集中在信心校准错误和橡皮图章式监督，生成性AI风险集中在谄媚和拟人化信任操纵，代理性AI风险集中在系统自主性增加时的监督可处理性；第三，EU AI Act第14条的监督架构比GCC更完善，但GCC监管文书包含用户意识、透明度和文化适宜性方面的考虑，且大语言模型对西方实体的文化偏误在阿拉伯语用户中造成信任校准问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了信任、校准和依赖三个概念的区别与联系，提出了按模态区分的AI风险分类框架，识别了监管框架中的文化盲区。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议从业者在部署AI系统时应区分信任、校准和依赖进行人因设计与评估；在GCC多司法管辖区部署时需兼顾EU AI Act监督义务与GCC特定的文化、语言和监管期望。

title:
No Peasant AI 

On the Coming Enclosure of Cognition, and What Most Societies Have Already Promised to Prevent
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
No Peasant AI 

On the Coming Enclosure of Cognition, and What Most Societies Have Already Promised to Prevent

declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This essay argues that artificial intelligence is best understood not as a tool, a chatbot, or a productivity aid, but as an emerging capability stack: cognitive, conversion, and production infrastructure at once. It helps people learn and reason; it helps them translate thought into the forms by which institutions read them; and it helps them produce the artifacts-code, designs, documents, prototypes, businesses-by which they are recognised and rewarded. If the capability stack is broadly available, AI may become the printing press of capability. If access is tiered by income, employer, school, university, or country, it may instead become a new scribal class-not a wall around books, but a wall around the interpreter, the tutor, the editor, the coder, and the production engine. The argument is not anti-AI. It is the opposite: precisely because AI can expand human agency, the architecture of access matters. Most modern states have, in one form or another, committed themselves to preventing the kind of stratification this essay describes. The piece is written in a diagnostic register. It does not propose a public utility, nor any single implementation model. It argues that the architecture of AI access must not be decided by default-because the architectures that have been decided by default, throughout history, have proven the most difficult to undo. The essay closes with a single testable prediction: the first societies to universalise meaningful AI access will stop wasting as much of their own population. This is a diagnostic essay rather than an empirical study; the empirical citations support specific subclaims, but the central argument is structural.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，人工智能不应被理解为工具或助手，而应被理解为一种新兴的"能力堆栈"——同时具备认知、转换和生产基础设施的功能。如果这种能力堆栈被广泛获取，AI将成为"能力的印刷术"；如果获取受到阶层、雇主、学校或国家限制，它可能成为新的"抄写阶级"。
AI.research_question: 人工智能应当被如何理解？其获取架构（architecture of access）对社会分层会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 现有对AI的主流理解（工具、聊天机器人、生产力助手）过于狭窄，未能捕捉AI对人类社会结构的深层影响。作者认为，AI获取的架构不能由"默认状态"决定，因为历史上这类默认架构最难被逆转。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力堆栈框架（Capability Stack）：AI的三层功能——认知基础设施（学习和推理）、转换基础设施（将思想转化为制度可读的形式）、生产基础设施（产出代码、设计、文档、原型、商业等被社会认可和奖励的制品）。
AI.method: 诊断性论文（diagnostic essay），非实证研究。通过结构性论证和历史类比（印刷术、抄写阶级）展开分析，辅以经验性引用支持具体子论点。
AI.findings: 1) AI是认知、转换和生产三层能力堆栈的组合；2) AI获取的平等性决定了它是"能力的印刷术"还是"新抄写阶级"；3) 多数现代国家已承诺防止此类阶层分化；4) 提出可检验预测：率先普及AI有意义获取的社会将停止浪费其人口潜能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"AI作为能力堆栈"的新概念框架，将AI从工具论提升到基础设施论，并引入历史类比（印刷术 vs. 抄写阶级）来理论化AI获取架构的社会影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示AI获取架构不能由默认状态决定，呼吁有意识地设计AI分发的制度安排，以避免新形式的阶层固化和人类潜能浪费。

title: Information Asymmetry in the Canadian and U.S. Credit Card Markets: A Comparative Analysis of Reward Valuation Transparency

detail.title: Information Asymmetry in the Canadian and U.S. Credit Card Markets: A Comparative Analysis of Reward Valuation Transparency

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of WalletSavvy, a personalized credit card recommendation platform operating in the Canadian and U.S. markets, and a co-founder of Gilmedia, a Toronto-based digital growth firm. The structured comparison database referenced in Section 5 of this paper was developed by the author through WalletSavvy. The author has no current commercial relationship with any credit card issuer or comparison platform named or alluded to in this paper. The illustrative cases in Section 6 do not identify specific products. They aggregate patterns observed across the comparison database to preserve the empirical character of the findings without enabling identification of any individual issuer or card. No part of this paper was prepared at the direction of, or with input from, any credit card issuer, comparison platform, regulator, or industry association.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is conceptual and analytical. It does not involve human subjects research, surveys of identifiable participants, patient data, biomedical research, or any data that would require institutional review board (IRB) or research ethics board (REB) approval. All empirical patterns referenced in the paper are drawn from publicly available regulatory documents, published academic literature, and the author's own anonymized aggregate observations of credit card product features. No grants, sponsored research arrangements, or industry funding supported the preparation of this paper.

detail.abstract: American households carry roughly $1.17 trillion in revolving credit card debt and pay annual percentage rates above 21 percent (Federal Reserve, 2024). Those numbers are large, and they receive most of the attention in policy debate and the press. They describe only one half of the credit card economy. The other half is rewards: cash back rates, sign-up bonuses, point earnings, and bundled ancillary benefits, on which issuers compete at least as aggressively as on price. The disclosure regimes in the United States and Canada were designed for the borrowing half. They are largely silent on the rewards half. This paper develops a framework for analyzing the resulting opacity, which I term reward valuation transparency, or RVT. I draw on roughly ten years of structured comparison work covering approximately 250 Canadian credit card products to propose a typology of three RVT failure modes (headline-rate opacity, conditional-value opacity, and comparability opacity) and apply the typology comparatively to the U.S. market. Both markets exhibit RVT failures, though through different mechanisms. The United States produces opacity primarily through reward program complexity and segmentation. Canada produces it primarily through limited statutory comparison infrastructure and concentrated issuer structure. I also identify a meta-RVT problem: the third-party comparison platforms that exist to resolve reward valuation introduce their own opacity through the affiliate compensation that funds them. The paper discusses implications for disclosure regulation, distributive consequences in light of recent evidence that rewards function as a regressive transfer, and the design of consumer-facing comparison tools. The paper does not recommend a specific policy. The choice between regulatory and market-based remedies is treated as an empirical question requiring further work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"奖励估值透明度"（RVT）框架，分析美加信用卡市场中奖励机制的信息不透明问题，识别三种RVT失败模式，并讨论其对监管、分配公平和比较工具设计的启示。
AI.research_question: 信用卡奖励机制（返现、积分、开卡奖励等）的信息透明度存在哪些系统性缺陷？美加两国的透明度失败模式有何异同？
AI.motivation: 美国消费者持有约1.17万亿美元循环信用卡债务，利率超21%，但政策讨论和媒体过度关注借贷端，忽视了同样重要的奖励端。现有信息披露制度仅针对借贷端，对奖励端几乎空白，导致消费者无法有效评估信用卡的真实价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 奖励估值透明度（Reward Valuation Transparency, RVT）框架；三种RVT失败模式：标称利率透明度失败、条件价值透明度失败、可比性透明度失败；元RVT问题（第三方平台的佣金利益冲突）。
AI.method: 结构化比较研究，覆盖约250种加拿大信用卡产品，近十年追踪分析；将加拿大得出的类型学框架比较应用于美国市场。
AI.findings: 美加两国均存在RVT失败，但机制不同：美国主要通过奖励计划的复杂性和细分市场产生不透明；加拿大主要通过有限的法律比较基础设施和集中的发卡机构结构产生不透明。此外，第三方比较平台因依赖附属佣金而产生元RVT问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统化提出RVT概念及三种失败模式的类型学，将信息披露分析从借贷端扩展至奖励端；识别出第三方平台的元RVT问题，丰富了透明度研究的理论层次。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信用卡信息披露监管改革提供分析框架；揭示奖励机制作为"累退性转移支付"的分配后果；为消费者比较工具的设计提供指导；不预设特定政策建议，将监管与市场解决方案的选择视为需进一步研究的实证问题。

title:
The Citizens Standard:
Transition Architecture and Migration Mechanics
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
The Citizens Standard:
Transition Architecture and Migration Mechanics
detail.abstract:
The Citizens Standard (Neo-Solon, 2026a) proposes a constitutional monetary architecture whose destination is well-specified. This paper addresses what the architectural paper defers: the path from the current discretionary monetary system to that destination. The central finding is that the Citizens Standard does not require a monetary revolution to begin. Its most powerful mechanism — universal locked equity compounding — can be launched today as a parallel sovereign wealth layer within the existing monetary system, requiring no Federal Reserve replacement, no constitutional amendment, and no banking restructuring at inception.

We specify a five-phase migration architecture in which each phase is self-contained, generates observable evidence, and creates the institutional conditions for the next phase. The phases span approximately 40 to 60 years from launch to full constitutionalization. We then address quantitatively the four hard transition problems the architectural paper acknowledges but does not resolve: existing government debt conversion mechanics, banking separation and credit stability under phased reserve requirements, equity valuation effects of universal systematic ownership flows, and the timing of constitutional lock credibility.

A central quantitative finding concerns the debt transition: a naïve analysis suggests Mode B requires a $2.3 trillion annual primary surplus to stabilize debt/GDP — an apparently impossible fiscal demand. This paper shows that analysis is incomplete. As legacy high-coupon nominal debt rolls to price-indexed instruments over approximately six years, the average sovereign coupon falls from 4.5 percent to approximately 1.0 percent under Mode B, collapsing the interest-growth spread from 3.2 to 0.3 percentage points. A Mode C bridge during Phase 1 and Phase 2, combined with modest fiscal consolidation of approximately 1 percent of GDP over ten years, produces a D/GDP trajectory declining from 127 percent at launch to 84 percent by Year 50 — materially better than the CBO's March 2025 projection of 156 percent by 2055 under current law. International analogues from Chile, Norway, Estonia, and Singapore provide empirical grounding for each phase's feasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"公民标准"（Citizens Standard）货币架构的渐进实施路径，论证其核心机制——全民锁定权益复利——可在不推翻现有货币体系的前提下启动，并设计了一个40-60年的五阶段迁移架构，定量解决了债务转换、银行分离、权益估值和宪法锁定等关键过渡问题。
AI.research_question: 如何从当前 discretionary 货币政策体系平稳过渡到"公民标准"宪法货币架构，并解决债务转换、银行分离、权益估值和宪法锁定可信度四大硬核过渡问题？
AI.motivation: "公民标准"架构论文（Neo-Solon, 2026a）明确了货币体系的最终目的地，但有意搁置了从现状到达该目的地的具体路径。本文旨在填补这一空白，论证过渡路径的可行性与可操作性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法货币架构；全民锁定权益复利机制；价格指数化债务转换；主权财富层平行运行理论；渐进式制度变迁理论。
AI.method: 规范分析结合定量建模。设计五阶段迁移架构（40-60年），运用债务动态方程分析债务/GDP轨迹，对比美国国会预算办公室（CBO）基准预测，并以智利、挪威、爱沙尼亚、新加坡等国经验作为各阶段可行性的实证参照。
AI.findings: (1) "公民标准"不需要货币革命即可启动，其核心机制可作为平行主权财富层在现有体系内运行；(2) 模式B下，旧有高息名义债务在约六年内滚动为价格指数化工具后，平均主权票面利率从4.5%降至约1.0%，利差从3.2个百分点缩至0.3个百分点；(3) 模式C桥梁 + 约GDP 1%的财政整固，可使债务/GDP从启动时的127%降至第50年的84%，优于CBO对当前政策下2055年156%的预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了渐进式宪法货币转型的完整理论框架，论证了"平行主权财富层"作为制度变迁中间形态的可行性，定量展示了债务存量转换的内生性财政改善机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可操作的货币体系转型路线图（五阶段、40-60年），给出了债务转换、银行分离的具体量化方案，并借鉴了智利、挪威、新加坡等国的实践经验。

title: Measuring the Memory Structure of Intraday Returns: Evidence from E-mini S&P 500 Futures

detail.title: Measuring the Memory Structure of Intraday Returns: Evidence from E-mini S&P 500 Futures
detail.abstract: Standard intraday trading systems treat consecutive returns as approximately independent, ignoring long-range dependence, fractional integration, volatility persistence, and multifractal regime mixing-properties that are measurable and consequential at the one-minute frequency. This paper implements and empirically validates a complete memory-structure measurement toolkit applied to E-mini S&P; 500 (ES) futures on the one-minute timeframe. The toolkit comprises three confidence-weighted Hurst estimators (R/S analysis, aggregated variance, absolute moments), the Geweke-Porter-Hudak (GPH) log-periodogram estimator for the ARFIMA fractional differencing parameter d, a Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MFDFA) spectrum estimator, and a volatility suite including realized, fractional, and FIGARCH-approximated conditional variance with leverage and jump diagnostics. All components are implemented in MQL5 as a single modular header file suitable for real-time use in indicators, Expert Advisors, and machine learning feature pipelines; the open-source implementation is documented in a companion article series (Brown, 2026a-d). Empirical analysis of 514 New York trading sessions (April 2024-March 2026, approximately 196,000 one-minute observations) yields four principal findings. First, the confidence-weighted Hurst blend produces H = 0.660 (median 0.662)-a strongly upward-biased estimate driven by short-range autocorrelation in the R/S statistic, as predicted by Lo (1991). Second, the GPH estimator, which is robust to this bias, gives pooled d =-0.057 and session-level mean d =-0.006 (SD = 0.121), consistent with near-random-walk behavior. The H-d discrepancy exceeds 0.1 in 75.1% of sessions, directly quantifying the R/S bias in real market data. Third, MFDFA singularity spectrum widths (delta-alpha, Legendre-transformed) average 0.415 (median 0.359), with 44.7% of sessions showing strong multifractal structure, confirming that opposing memory regimes coexist within individual sessions. Fourth, volatility clustering is present but modest at the minute level (mean clustering index 0.071), with jump intensity averaging 0.86%. Together these findings establish that ES M1 intraday returns are near-memoryless in aggregate but heterogeneous in structure, and that the R/S Hurst estimator systematically overstates persistence at this frequency.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并验证了一套完整的记忆结构测量工具包，应用于E-mini S&P 500期货1分钟高频数据，发现其日内收益整体接近无记忆随机游走行为，但存在显著的多重分形异质性，且R/S Hurst估计量会系统性高估持续性。
AI.research_question: 标准日内交易系统将连续收益视为近似独立，忽略了长记忆性、分数阶积分、波动率持续性和多重分形体制混合等可测量且重要的特征。本文旨在系统测量和验证1分钟频率下ES期货的记忆结构。
AI.motivation: 高频交易中通常假设收益独立，但实际市场数据可能表现出复杂记忆结构。量化这些结构对于交易策略、风险管理和机器学习特征工程具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 长记忆过程（Hurst指数、ARFIMA模型）、多重分形分析（MFDFA）、波动率聚类（FIGARCH）、R/S偏差理论（Lo, 1991）。
AI.method: 1. 三种置信度加权Hurst估计量（R/S分析、聚合方差法、绝对矩法）；2. GPH对数周期图估计量（ARFIMA分数差分参数d）；3. MFDFA多重分形谱估计；4. 波动率套件（已实现波动率、分数阶波动率、FIGARCH条件方差、杠杆效应与跳跃诊断）。所有工具在MQL5中实现为模块化头文件，分析涵盖514个纽约交易时段（约196,000个1分钟观测值）。
AI.findings: 1. 置信加权Hurst混合估计H=0.660（中位数0.662），呈现强向上偏差，由R/S统计量中的短程自相关驱动；2. GPH估计的d=-0.057，会话均值d=-0.006，接近随机游走；H-d差异超过0.1的会话占75.1%；3. MFDFA奇异谱宽度平均0.415，44.7%的会话呈强多重分形结构；4. 波动率聚类温和（均值0.071），跳跃强度平均0.86%。结论：ES M1日内收益整体无记忆，但结构异质；R/S Hurst估计量系统性高估持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在高频场景下实证验证了Lo（1991）关于R/S统计量短程自相关偏差的理论预测，量化了H-d差异在真实市场中的存在程度（75.1%的会话差异>0.1）；2. 揭示了1分钟频率下"整体无记忆、局部多重分形"的非对称记忆结构，挑战了传统独立同分布假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了可在MQL5中实时运行的开源记忆结构测量工具包，适用于指标、EA和机器学习特征管线；2. 为高频交易系统的模型选择提供了实证依据：应采用GPH等偏差稳健估计量而非R/S Hurst，且需考虑多重分形异质性。

title: Taxation, Fiscal Consolidation, and Debt Sustainability in Kenya’s Finance Bills: A Macroeconomic and Theoretical Evaluation

detail.title: Taxation, Fiscal Consolidation, and Debt Sustainability in Kenya’s Finance Bills: A Macroeconomic and Theoretical Evaluation
