detail.abstract:
Background: Civil registration systems in many low- and middle-income countries capture only a fraction of vital events, with deaths recorded less completely than births. Globally, female deaths are more often unregistered, yet evidence from Kenya is lacking. We examined gender bias in adult death registration across three Kenyan Health and Demographic Surveillance System (HDSS) sites.

Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional household survey of 1,363 households reporting a recent death (2022–2023) across three HDSS sites in Nairobi, Kisumu, and Kilifi. Mixed-effects logistic regression identified determinants of registration, and Fairlie decomposition quantified the gender gap. Reported reasons for (non)registration were also analysed.

Findings: Among 1,111 adult deaths, registration was 22·8% overall and significantly higher in males than females (26·1% vs 18·8%; p=0·006). Among females, registration odds were higher in those aged 45–64 than 65–84 years (AOR 2·32; p=0·019) and in Muslims (AOR 2·53; p=0·042), and lower in the unemployed (AOR 0·43; p=0·004). Among males, odds were lower for single individuals (AOR 0·30; p=0·012) and home deaths (AOR 0·64; p=0·048), and higher with employment or retirement (AOR 2·16; p=0·001) and greater wealth. Observable factors, principally economic activity and place of death, explained 50·2% of the 7·4 percentage-point gender gap. Inheritance needs and social benefits motivated registration; low awareness, perceived low benefit, and cost were key barriers.

Interpretation: Gender bias in adult death registration persists in Kenya, driven by socioeconomic and structural barriers that disadvantage women, underscoring the need for gender-responsive civil registration and vital statistics reforms.

AI.tldr: 肯尼亚三个健康与人口监测系统（HDSS）站点中，成年人死亡登记率仅为22.8%，女性登记率（18.8%）显著低于男性（26.1%），性别差距约7.4个百分点；经济活动和死亡地点等可观测因素解释了50.2%的性别差距，继承需求和社会福利是登记动机，而认知不足、感知收益低和成本是主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚成年人死亡登记中是否存在性别偏差？其决定因素和机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内女性死亡登记不足问题普遍存在，但肯尼亚缺乏相关证据；民事登记系统在低收入和中等收入国家覆盖率有限，识别性别偏差有助于推动性别敏感的登记改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别偏差理论、健康社会决定因素框架、民事登记与生命统计（CRVS）系统改革理论
AI.method: 横截面家庭调查（1,363户家庭，2022-2023年数据）；混合效应逻辑回归识别登记决定因素；Fairlie分解量化性别差距的构成因素；描述性分析报道（非）登记原因。
AI.findings: 1. 整体死亡登记率22.8%，男性（26.1%）显著高于女性（18.8%）；2. 女性中，45-64岁（vs 65-84岁）和穆斯林登记率更高，失业者登记率更低；男性中，单身和家庭死亡登记率更低，在职/退休和财富水平高者登记率更高；3. 经济活动和死亡地点解释了50.2%的性别差距；4. 继承需求和社会福利激励登记，低认知、感知收益低和成本是主要障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证证明了低收入国家中死亡登记性别偏差的存在及具体规模；通过分解方法揭示了经济活动和死亡地点等结构性因素在性别差距中的关键作用；丰富了CRVS系统性别不平等的研究框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚及类似低收入国家推动性别敏感的民事登记改革提供了实证依据；识别出可干预的关键因素（如提高女性经济活动参与、改善院外死亡登记流程）；为政策制定者降低登记成本、提升公众认知提供了具体方向。

title: Reverse Sanctions Evasion: The Case of Russian Oil Re-exports to the European Union via Georgia
affiliations: Caucasus University and

detail.title: Reverse Sanctions Evasion: The Case of Russian Oil Re-exports to the European Union via Georgia
detail.abstract: This paper examines reverse sanctions evasion by analyzing how Russian oil and petroleum products subject to EU and G7 restrictions are redistributed through third countries. Using Georgia as a case study, it extends sanctions evasion theory beyond the conventional Sender-to-Target paradigm by introducing a Target-to-Sender trade configuration in global energy markets. Drawing on monthly trade data for petroleum products (HS 2710) from January 2018 to June 2025, the study applies a difference-indifferences (DiD) framework to evaluate trade adjustments following the March 2022 oil sanctions. Results show that Georgia's imports of Russian petroleum products increased significantly relative to other suppliers, indicating trade redirection toward intermediary economies. Export responses occur primarily through prices rather than quantities, with revenues shifting toward non-coalition markets under the price cap regime. The findings reveal a structural vulnerability of energy sanctions, whereby intermediary jurisdictions facilitate indirect circulation of sanctioned commodities within formally legal trade structures.

AI.tldr: 本文以格鲁吉亚为案例，研究俄罗斯石油产品如何通过第三国规避欧盟与G7的制裁，发现制裁后格鲁吉亚从俄罗斯进口显著增加，且出口调整主要通过价格而非数量实现，揭示了能源制裁的结构性漏洞。
AI.research_question: 受制裁的俄罗斯石油及石油产品如何通过第三国进行逆向规避流通？
AI.motivation: 传统制裁规避研究多聚焦"发送国→目标国"的单向范式，忽视了"目标国→发送国"的反向贸易渠道，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制裁规避理论（逆向贸易扩展）、价格上限机制理论、贸易转移理论。
AI.method: 运用2018年1月至2025年6月格鲁吉亚石油产品（HS 2710）月度贸易数据，构建双重差分（DiD）模型，评估2022年3月石油制裁后的贸易调整效应。
AI.findings: 1）制裁后格鲁吉亚从俄罗斯进口石油产品显著增加，呈现贸易转向中介经济体特征；2）出口调整主要通过价格渠道而非数量渠道实现；3）价格上限机制下，收入向非联盟市场转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"目标国→发送国"逆向制裁规避理论，拓展了传统制裁规避分析框架；2）揭示了中介司法管辖区在形式上合法的贸易结构中促进受制裁商品间接流通的结构性脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别制裁漏洞、优化制裁执行机制（尤其是价格上限监管）提供实证依据，提示需加强第三方中转国监管。

title: Green Growth Beliefs and Individual Climate Action: Evidence from Pre-Paris Agreement Europe

detail.title: Green Growth Beliefs and Individual Climate Action: Evidence from Pre-Paris Agreement Europe

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses anonymised, publicly available secondary data (Standard Eurobarometer 83.4, GESIS Data Archive). No ethics board approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The European Green Deal and comparable national climate strategies invest heavily in cobenefit communication-the argument that fighting climate change boosts jobs and economic competitiveness. But does this framing activate or suppress individual climate action? Using Standard Eurobarometer 83.4 (May-June 2015, 27 EU member states, N = 23,556), collected before the Paris Agreement and the European Green Deal, this paper finds no supporting evidence for the assumption that co-benefit beliefs stimulate individual action. Using Poisson and negative binomial count models alongside a structural equation model (SEM), the paper documents a consistent negative association: green growth belief is associated with fewer personal climate actions (𝑃𝑜𝑖𝑠𝑠𝑜𝑛: 𝑏 =-0.118, 𝑝 < 0.001; SEM direct effect: 𝑏 =-0.381, 𝑝 < 0.001), even after controlling for environmental concern. The SEM further reveals that green growth beliefs are negatively associated with environmental concern (𝑏 =-0.897, 𝑝 < 0.001), which in turn positively predicts action (𝑏 = 0.057, 𝑝 < 0.001). The indirect pathway accounts for a portion of the total negative effect. These findings are consistent with a techno-optimism substitution hypothesis: individuals believing systemic solutions will deliver climate action may reduce their own behavioral engagement. Results are robust across distributional assumptions. The pre-Paris Agreement setting ensures estimates reflect genuine attitudinal heterogeneity rather than institutional messaging effects. These findings should be interpreted as behavioral associations rather than evidence of causal displacement. Rather than challenging the validity of co-benefit communication strategies, this paper aims to refine understanding of their behavioral implications.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2015年欧盟27国的大样本调查数据发现，认为气候行动能促进就业和经济竞争力的"绿色增长信念"，反而与个人气候行动减少相关，且该信念会削弱环境关注度，符合"技术乐观主义替代假说"。
AI.research_question: "绿色增长"（气候行动促进就业与竞争力）的共益沟通框架，是激活还是抑制个人的气候行动？
AI.motivation: 欧盟绿色新政及各国气候战略大量采用"共益沟通"策略，但该框架对个体行为的影响尚不明确，需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术乐观主义替代假说（techno-optimism substitution hypothesis）：相信系统性解决方案能解决气候问题的人，可能减少自身行为参与。
AI.method: 标准欧洲晴雨表83.4数据（2015年，27个欧盟成员国，N=23,556）；泊松回归、负二项回归、结构方程模型（SEM）。
AI.findings: 绿色增长信念与个人气候行动呈显著负相关（泊松b=-0.118, p<0.001；SEM直接效应b=-0.381, p<0.001）；绿色增长信念与环境关注度负相关（b=-0.897, p<0.001），而环境关注度正向预测行动（b=0.057, p<0.001），间接路径放大了总负面效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次大规模实证检验"共益沟通"对个体行为的负面关联，支持技术乐观主义替代假说；区分了直接与间接（通过环境关注度）两种影响路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者：强调气候行动的经济竞争力红利，可能无意中削弱公众的个人参与意愿；需谨慎设计气候沟通策略，避免"技术替代个人行动"的负面效应。

reference: Stanford Law School Law and Policy Lab, 2025 Fall
title: AI in Criminal Justice: Why Governance Matters and How to Make it Work
affiliations: J.D. Stanford Law School, J.D. Stanford Law School, J.D. Stanford Law School, J.D. Stanford Law School, J.D. Stanford Law School, J.D. Stanford Law School, J.D. Stanford Law School, , , Harvard Law School and Stanford Law School

detail.title: AI in Criminal Justice: Why Governance Matters and How to Make it Work

publicationDetails.detailsText: Stanford Law School Law and Policy Lab, 2025 Fall

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly embedding itself into the core machinery of the criminal justice system, powering everyday decisions from police analysis of digital evidence and pattern detection in crime data to prosecutorial discovery management, charging recommendations, algorithmic risk assessments in courts, and large language models for summarizing records and drafting documents. These tools promise efficiency gains—processing vast data volumes, reducing backlogs, and optimizing scarce resources in an overburdened system—but they also carry profound risks: embedding bias, producing opaque or unreliable outputs, shifting unmonitored power to vendors, and influencing high-stakes liberty decisions like arrests, detention, sentencing, and release. The central problem is that AI capabilities are deploying without sufficient understanding of their mechanics, failure modes, or implications for constitutional rights, democratic accountability, and system legitimacy. Criminal-justice entities who encounter AI tools—thousands of under-resourced police departments, prosecutors’ offices, courts, and probation units—lack the technical expertise to evaluate these tools rigorously, while vendors market directly to practitioners. This creates a governance gap: even well-intentioned actors cannot reliably apply emerging standards amid rapid technological changes, risking uneven, superficial oversight that undermines public trust.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能在刑事司法系统中的快速嵌入及其带来的治理挑战：AI工具在提升效率的同时，因缺乏技术评估能力和监管机制，可能导致偏见、不透明、权力转移等风险，危及宪法权利和民主问责。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在刑事司法系统中的部署如何影响宪法权利、民主问责和系统合法性？在缺乏技术专业知识的情况下，如何弥合AI治理的缺口？
AI.motivation: AI正迅速嵌入刑事司法系统的核心决策环节（如证据分析、风险评估、量刑建议等），但缺乏对其运作机制、失效模式及对宪法权利影响的充分理解，存在严重的治理真空。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法治理理论、技术问责框架、民主合法性理论、宪法权利保护理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析与规范性论证，结合对现有AI应用场景的批判性审查。
AI.findings: AI在刑事司法中的使用存在以下关键问题：1) 偏见嵌入与不可靠输出；2) 决策不透明；3) 权力向技术供应商不受监督地转移；4) 影响逮捕、拘留、量刑等高度敏感的决策；5) 基层司法机构缺乏技术评估能力；6) 现有治理标准难以应对快速技术变革。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI在刑事司法中的"治理缺口"现象，将技术治理、民主问责与宪法权利保护理论相结合，为理解AI对司法系统合法性的影响提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、司法机构和AI开发者提供了识别和应对AI治理挑战的方向，强调了建立技术评估能力、加强透明度监管和防止权力非正当转移的重要性。

title: The Neurobiology of Controllability: Reorienting Clinical Interventions Beyond the Default State of Learned Helplessness
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Neurobiology of Controllability: Reorienting Clinical Interventions Beyond the Default State of Learned Helplessness

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n.a.
declarations.ethicsApproval: n.a.
declarations.funderStatement: n.a.

detail.abstract: The mammalian brain's default response to prolonged, inescapable stress is not a learned failure of motivation, but an evolutionarily hardwired state of metabolic energy conservation. Historically, clinical frameworks addressing depression, chronic trauma, and behavioral passivity have been anchored in the behavioral premise of "learned helplessness"-the theory that organisms actively compute a cognitive expectation of powerlessness. A major neurobiological paradigm shift has inverted this foundational assumption, demonstrating that behavioral passivity under prolonged stress is an unconditioned, automatic survival mechanism mediated by the hyperactivation of serotonergic neurons in the midbrain dorsal raphe nucleus (DRN). True resilience relies on an active, top-down cognitive process mediated by the ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC) that tracks behavioral-environmental contingencies to inhibit this default brainstem freeze response. This synthesis reorients the clinical paradigm from "unlearning helplessness" to "actively training controllability." It provides a neurobiologically grounded, operational framework for structuring micro-contingency loops in Behavioral Activation (BA), executing cognitive attributional realignment in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), and sequencing interventions within trauma-informed care.

AI.tldr: 本文颠覆了"习得性无助"的传统理论，提出长期应激下的行为被动是脑干硬连接的生存机制，而非认知失败。真正的心理韧性依赖于前额叶皮层主动抑制这一默认反应，从而将临床范式从"消除无助"转向"主动训练控制感"。
AI.research_question: 长期、不可逃避应激下的行为被动性，其神经生物学本质是什么？是习得的认知无助，还是先天性的生存机制？
AI.motivation: 传统"习得性无助"理论主导了抑郁、创伤等临床框架数十年，但其神经生物学基础存在根本性缺陷。作者试图纠正这一范式，提出基于进化神经科学的替代解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 进化神经科学视角：行为被动是硬连接的代谢能量保存机制；2. 中脑背侧中缝核（DRN）5-羟色胺能神经元过度激活假说；3. 腹内侧前额叶皮层（vmPFC）的"自下而上"抑制控制理论。
AI.method: 本文为理论综述与神经生物学范式整合，通过回顾和重新解读已有的动物模型（尤其是DRN和vmPFC相关研究）及临床证据，构建新的理论框架。
AI.findings: 1. 行为被动是无条件、自动化的生存机制，而非认知学习的结果；2. 真正的韧性是vmPFC主动追踪行为-环境关联、抑制脑干僵直反应的能力；3. 临床干预应从"消除习得性无助"转向"主动训练控制感"。
AI.theory_contributions: 从根本上颠覆了"习得性无助"这一临床心理学支柱理论，将其从认知学习范式重新定位为进化神经科学范式，为理解应激反应、抑郁和创伤提供了新的理论支点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为行为激活疗法（BA）设计微观控制感循环提供了神经生物学依据；2. 为认知行为疗法（CBT）的归因重训提供了可操作的理论框架；3. 为创伤知情护理中的干预排序提供了神经科学的指导原则。

reference: GWU Law School Public Law Research Paper
title: Exiting the Supreme Court's Market for Lemons
affiliations: George Washington University - Law School, George Washington Law School and George Washington University - Law School

detail.title: Exiting the Supreme Court's Market for Lemons

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Law School Public Law Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this Article, we argue that the Supreme Court has engineered a "market for lemons" in public law by systematically raising the cost of producing high-quality regulation while subsidizing its corporate-sponsored alternatives, and that states should respond by creating their own competitive regulatory markets. We provide a constitutionally protected toolkit for doing so: leveraging state procurement power, building proactive regulatory architectures, deploying criminal enforcement to recharter corporate offenders, and coordinating through interstate compacts. Drawing on George Akerlof's Nobel Prize-winning theory of information asymmetry, we show how the Court, acting as the regulatory marketplace's primary market-maker, has imposed a series of asymmetric doctrinal taxes-seemingly neutral legal rules that dramatically raise the cost of producing high-quality regulation while leaving its low-quality alternatives untouched. The elimination of Chevron deference in Loper Bright, the procedural obstacle tax of Jarkesy, the destabilization of regulatory finality in Corner Post, and the indeterminate veto of the Major Questions Doctrine each function as such a tax, driving high-quality rules from the field and locking the federal system into a low-quality equilibrium. The beneficiaries of this regime are not firms that compete on quality but firms that compete on their ability to externalize costs and harms onto others, and they will protect that advantage fiercely. With the Court standing ready to block federal reform, the most pragmatic path forward is institutional competition. States retain constitutionally protected authority that the Court cannot easily reach, and by exercising it, they can create alternative marketplaces where regulatory peaches can actually clear.

AI.tldr: 本文认为最高法院通过在公法中制造"柠檬市场"——系统性地提高高质量监管的成本同时补贴企业资助的低质量替代方案，各州应利用宪法赋予的权力创建竞争性监管市场来应对。文章基于阿克洛夫的信息不对称理论，分析了Loper Bright、Jarkesy、Corner Post等判例如何作为"不对称教义税"驱逐高质量规则，并提出州级行动工具箱。
AI.research_question: 最高法院的司法裁判如何通过信息不对称机制在公法中制造"柠檬市场"，以及各州应如何利用宪法保留权力构建竞争性监管市场来应对这一局面？
AI.motivation: 联邦层面的高质量监管被最高法院的一系列判例系统性削弱，而低质量监管（有利于成本外部化的企业）却得以保留，形成了监管领域的"劣币驱逐良币"困境，亟需寻找可行的制度出路。
AI.theoretical_framework: 乔治·阿克洛夫的"柠檬市场"理论（信息不对称导致高质量产品被驱逐）；市场制造者（market-maker）理论，将最高法院定位为监管市场的核心做市商。
AI.method: doctrinal analysis（判例分析），运用信息经济学理论对Loper Bright、Jarkesy、Corner Post、Major Questions Doctrine等近期最高法院判例进行系统分析。
AI.findings: 最高法院通过一系列"不对称教义税"系统性地提高了高质量监管的成本：Loper Bright取消Chevron尊重原则、Jarkesy设置程序障碍税、Corner Post破坏监管终局性、以及重大问题原则的不确定否决权。这些规则共同将联邦监管体系锁定在低质量均衡中，受益者是那些通过成本外部化而非质量竞争获利的企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 将阿克洛夫的信息不对称理论（柠檬市场）创新性地应用于公法领域，提出了"不对称教义税"概念，揭示了最高法院作为监管市场做市商的角色及其系统性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各州提供了四方面宪法保护的工具箱：利用州采购权、构建主动型监管架构、运用刑事执法重新特许企业、以及通过州际契约协调行动，为联邦监管困境提供了可行的替代路径。

title: The Import Substitution Trap in the Realities of the Automotive Industry

detail.title: The Import Substitution Trap in the Realities of the Automotive Industry
detail.abstract: The article examines mechanisms underlying the formation of the "import substitution trap," which is a stable ineffective institution that serves as a means of protecting national producers from foreign competition. The costs and risks of rooting this institution in the Russian automotive industry are analyzed, the import substitution strategies of the Russian government at the current stage of the industry's development are investigated, the experience of import substitution in the foreign automotive industry is summarized. The conclusion is substantiated that the import substitution policy brings short-term effects but is disadvantageous in the long term. Domestic substitutes can gain a strong market position but their success is fragile and requires continued government support and protectionist patronage. The author shows that the policy of import substitution becomes successful when it relies on competition, when the domestic import substitute, having entered the market and strengthened its position, is gradually deprived of preferential conditions, and the state support of its manufacturer is gradually cut while the market is transferred to a "freewheeling" mode for all players.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了“进口替代陷阱”的形成机制，以俄罗斯汽车工业为案例，论证进口替代政策短期有效但长期不利，只有依赖竞争并逐步取消保护才能成功。
AI.research_question: 进口替代陷阱的形成机制是什么？为什么进口替代政策在长期中可能失效？
AI.motivation: 揭示进口替代政策在俄罗斯汽车工业中的实际效果，批判性分析其短期收益与长期代价，并为政策制定者提供替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学中的“无效制度锁定”理论（进口替代陷阱）、保护主义与竞争政策理论。
AI.method: 案例研究（俄罗斯汽车工业）、成本-风险分析、国内外进口替代经验比较分析。
AI.findings: 进口替代政策在短期内有效，但长期会导致低效制度固化；国内替代品依赖政府保护，缺乏竞争力；成功的进口替代需要以竞争为基础，逐步撤除保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“进口替代陷阱”的概念与形成机制，丰富了制度经济学中关于无效制度锁定的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家（尤其是俄罗斯）的产业政策制定提供了实证依据与政策建议：进口替代应依赖竞争而非保护主义。

title: The Apprenticeship Externality: Generative AI, Entry-Level Work, and the Future Supply of Expertise

detail.title: The Apprenticeship Externality: Generative AI, Entry-Level Work, and the Future Supply of Expertise
detail.abstract: Task-based models of automation typically assume that human comparative advantage is replenished through the creation of new labor-intensive tasks. This paper argues that generative AI may weaken that assumption by automating the entry-level tasks through which workers acquire the expertise needed to perform future complex tasks. We call this the apprenticeship externality: firms choosing to automate junior tasks do not internalise the social cost of eliminating the learning pathway that produces tomorrow's senior experts, generating systematic overautomation relative to the social optimum. We formalise this in a two-period overlappinggenerations model with heterogeneous junior tasks, each characterised by a net private automation gain g(i) and a task-specific learning value ℓ(i). The decentralised firm automates task i whenever g(i) > 0; the social planner automates only when g(i) exceeds the discounted learning cost βℓ(i)MP_H. The over-automation region 𝓞 = {i : 0 < g(i) < βℓ(i)MP_H} identifies exactly which tasks are privately profitable but socially inefficient to automate. In the short run, seniority bias emerges when AI and expert judgment are complements (γ > 0): expert wages rise while junior wages fall. When AI substitutes for expert deliverables directly (γ ≤ 0), expert wages need not rise, but the pipeline consequence holds regardless. In the long run, absent alternative formation channels, the expert stock decays geometrically. The welfare loss equals the discounted value of human capital destroyed on tasks in 𝓞. Policy implications include apprenticeship subsidies, tax credits for preserving human training tasks, and protected junior task rotations in AI-exposed occupations.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了"学徒外部性"概念，指出生成式AI自动化入门级任务会破坏劳动者获取专业技能的路径，导致社会层面的过度自动化。通过两期叠代模型，论文识别了哪些任务在私人层面有自动化激励但在社会层面效率低下，并讨论了相应的政策含义。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI通过自动化入门级任务，如何破坏劳动者积累专业技能的学习路径，从而导致社会层面的过度自动化？
AI.motivation: 传统的任务自动化模型假设人类比较优势会通过新劳动密集型任务的创造得到补充，但生成式AI可能通过自动化入门级任务来破坏这一假设，因为入门级任务是劳动者获取未来复杂任务所需专业知识的途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期叠代模型（OLG模型），包含异质性入门级任务，每个任务具有净私人自动化收益g(i)和任务特定学习价值ℓ(i)。区分分散决策与社会最优的自动化条件，定义了过度自动化区域𝓞。
AI.method: 理论建模，两期叠代（OLG）模型，比较静态分析。
AI.findings: 1）分散决策下企业自动化条件为g(i)>0，社会最优条件为g(i)>βℓ(i)MP_H，两者差距定义了过度自动化区域𝓞。2）短期内，当AI与专家判断互补（γ>0）时，出现"资历偏误"：专家工资上涨，初级工资下降。3）长期内，缺乏替代渠道时，专家存量呈几何衰减。4）福利损失等于𝓞中任务上被摧毁的人力资本贴现价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"学徒外部性"概念，将自动化决策的社会成本内生化，丰富了任务自动化理论中的比较优势补充机制讨论，拓展了AI对人力资本积累影响的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可操作的政策工具：学徒补贴、保留人类培训任务的税收优惠、以及受AI影响职业中的初级任务轮换保护制度。

title: Revisiting Geopolitical Alignment
affiliations: Technical University of Darmstadt - Department of Economics

detail.title: Revisiting Geopolitical Alignment
detail.abstract: In a multipolar global order, properly measuring countries' geopolitical alignment is an ever-important research objective. This paper assesses empirically the behaviour of several countries through their UNGA voting patters. I show that, in order to understand the relative positioning of countries with respect to competing hegemons, existing alignment measures need to be complemented with a new one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的衡量国家地缘政治联盟的指标，以补充现有方法，通过分析联合国大会投票模式来理解多极世界秩序下国家间的相对定位。
AI.research_question: 在多极全球秩序中，如何更准确地衡量国家的地缘政治联盟（alignment）？
AI.motivation: 现有联盟衡量指标不足以理解国家相对于竞争性霸权国家的相对定位，需要开发新的补充性指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多极国际关系理论、地缘政治联盟理论、联合国投票行为分析框架
AI.method: 基于联合国大会投票模式的实证分析，提出新的联盟测量指标
AI.findings: 现有联盟衡量指标存在不足，需要新的指标来补充对多极秩序下国家相对定位的理解。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新的地缘政治联盟衡量指标，补充和完善了现有国际关系理论中对国家联盟测量的方法论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和国际关系研究者提供了更准确评估多极世界中各国地缘政治立场的分析工具。

title: Forest Governance during the 2009 Economic Crisis in Greece: A Qualitative Analysis
affiliations: University of Reading

detail.title: Forest Governance during the 2009 Economic Crisis in Greece: A Qualitative Analysis
detail.abstract: Studies addressing the impacts of economic crises onto the Greek forest regime focus on industry or trade, or address forests within the broader environmental context. While quantitative data may capture and describe trends, qualitative data has the ability to offer unique perspectives, causal mechanisms and explanations in specific contexts. This study examines developments in the Greek forest regime since the beginning of the 2009 economic crisis through the lens of prominent Greek forest actors. Representatives from the most important actors in the regime were interviewed, namely the ministry of environment, the Hellenic Fire Corps, EKBY, WWF Greece, and the Central Union of Greek Municipalities. Thematic analysis determined 4 major themes with respect to the developments, namely Political influence, public participation, forest management, and power dynamics, and 2 broader themes, namely developments before and after the economic crisis. The lack of funds and personnel in major actors was the most addressed issue, while a more state-reactive market driven approach was also identified since the beginning of the economic crisis.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过访谈希腊森林领域关键行动者，探讨2009年经济危机以来希腊森林制度的发展变化，发现资金和人员短缺是最突出问题，并识别出危机后向国家反应性市场驱动方式的转变。
AI.research_question: 2009年经济危机如何影响希腊森林制度的发展？
AI.motivation: 以往关于经济危机对希腊森林影响的研究多聚焦产业或贸易层面，或仅在更广泛的环境背景下讨论森林，缺乏从森林行动者视角对制度变迁的质性深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定性研究方法论，主题分析法，制度变迁理论
AI.method: 对希腊森林制度中五个关键行动者（环境部、希腊消防队、EKBY、WWF希腊、希腊城市中央联盟）的代表进行半结构化访谈，并采用主题分析法对访谈数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 识别出4个主要主题（政治影响、公众参与、森林管理、权力动态）和2个更宏观的主题（危机前与危机后的发展）。资金和人员短缺是最常被提及的问题；危机后出现了更为国家反应性的市场驱动方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过质性视角揭示了经济危机如何通过行动者感知的因果机制影响森林制度变迁，弥补了量化研究在解释机制上的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为希腊及类似情境国家的森林政策制定者提供了危机时期森林治理挑战的具体洞察，尤其是资源短缺和治理模式转变方面的实证依据。

title: A Risk-Aware Stochastic Program for Pandemic Resource Allocation under Uncertainty
affiliations: FAMU-FSU College of Engineering and Florida State University

detail.title: A Risk-Aware Stochastic Program for Pandemic Resource Allocation under Uncertainty
detail.abstract: This study investigates risk-informed healthcare resource allocation during pandemics under uncertain epidemic progression and hospital demand. The existing stochastic programming approaches that consider expected values are not able to perform well under low-probability high-consequence pandemic outcomes. To explicitly address tail risks associated with such severe outbreak scenarios, the paper proposes a stochastic epidemic optimization model that incorporates Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) in the objective function and explicitly reflects the decision maker’s risk preference. Specifically, we propose a nonlinear stochastic program based on a Susceptible-Infected-Removed (SIR) epidemic model, in which the objective function is formulated as a linear combination of the average unmet demand and CVaR, both of which are computed over a set of scenarios and are weighted by a risk-aversion parameter. Uncertainty in epidemiological parameters and hospitalization ratios is accounted for in the stochastic program through Monte Carlo simulation and a maximal diversity selection (MDS) scenario reduction approach. The proposed method is compared to a benchmark greedy heuristic method and clustering-based scenario reduction method. A real-data case study of COVID-19 pandemic in Florida demonstrates the efficacy of the proposed method and compares it to the benchmark method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于条件风险价值（CVaR）的随机流行病优化模型，用于在大流行期间进行风险敏感的医疗资源分配，以应对低概率高后果的极端疫情情景。
AI.research_question: 如何在疫情发展不确定、医院需求不确定的背景下，进行风险敏感的医疗资源分配？
AI.motivation: 传统随机规划方法仅考虑期望值，在低概率、高后果的极端疫情情景下表现不佳，无法有效管理尾部风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件风险价值（CVaR）、SIR流行病模型、随机规划、蒙特卡洛模拟、最大多样性选择（MDS）情景缩减。
AI.method: 构建非线性随机规划模型，目标函数为平均未满足需求与CVaR的线性组合，由风险厌恶参数加权；采用蒙特卡洛模拟生成不确定性情景，并用MDS方法进行情景缩减。
AI.findings: 所提出的CVaR优化方法在应对极端疫情情景时优于贪婪启发式方法和基于聚类的传统情景缩减方法；基于佛罗里达州COVID-19真实数据的案例验证了模型有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CVaR引入流行病医疗资源分配问题，拓展了风险厌恶视角下的随机优化理论在公共卫生应急管理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者提供了一种可量化风险偏好的医疗资源分配工具，有助于在极端疫情情景下提升资源配置的稳健性，减少灾难性后果。

reference: Liberty Street Economics; https://doi.org/10.59576/lse.20260601
title: Remote Work Leaves Younger Workers Sidelined
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York, University of Virginia - Department of Economics and Harvard University

detail.title: Remote Work Leaves Younger Workers Sidelined

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Youth unemployment has risen dramatically since the pandemic—as has the prevalence of remote work. Our analysis suggests that these trends are related, with remote work making it more difficult for managers to train and mentor new employees. Accordingly, companies may be reluctant to hire less-experienced workers in distributed work arrangements. We estimate that remote work can explain 64 percent of the recent increase in unemployment among young college graduates. Further, the timing of this surge suggests that remote work—not generative AI—explains the bulk of the rise in youth unemployment.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/06/remote-work-leaves-younger-workers-sidelined/

AI.tldr: 远程工作导致疫情期间青年失业率大幅上升，因为远程办公使管理者难以培训和指导新员工，企业因此不愿在分布式工作安排中雇佣经验较少的年轻劳动者。研究发现远程工作可以解释年轻大学毕业生失业率近期增长的64%，且其影响远超生成式AI。
AI.research_question: 远程工作与青年失业率上升之间是否存在因果关系？远程工作对青年失业的影响程度有多大？
AI.motivation: 疫情后青年失业率与远程工作普及率同步大幅上升，研究者试图探究两者之间的关联性，并量化远程工作对青年失业的贡献程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 远程工作降低了管理者对新员工进行培训和指导的效果，企业因此不愿在分布式工作安排中雇佣缺乏经验的年轻劳动者。
AI.method: 基于疫情后美国劳动力市场数据的统计分析，对远程工作普及率与青年失业率进行关联估计。
AI.findings: 远程工作可以解释年轻大学毕业生失业率近期增长的64%；远程工作对青年失业的影响远大于生成式AI。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了远程工作与青年失业之间的因果关系机制，即远程工作削弱了管理者培训和指导新员工的能力，从而抑制了企业对年轻劳动者的雇佣意愿。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和企业关注远程工作模式对青年就业的不利影响，提示需要设计更有效的远程培训和指导机制来缓解青年失业问题。

reference: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 849
title: Zombies, Insolvency Reform, and Misallocation of Capital
affiliations: Asian Development Bank and University of Southampton

detail.title: Zombies, Insolvency Reform, and Misallocation of Capital

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 849

detail.abstract: Distressed and zombie firms are widespread in economies with weak insolvency regimes. This study investigates whether reforming insolvency laws can reduce capital misallocation. We introduce a framework for decomposing financial misallocation and derive metrics adequate to capture two conceptually distinct sources of inefficiency. The first refers to composition misallocation from inefficient leverage distribution, while the second refers to scale misallocation from suboptimal capital allocation among firms. Using firm-level data from 22 economies between 2003 and 2024, we find that effective reforms significantly reduce scale misallocation, especially in sectors with a high concentration of distressed and zombie firms. Event studies reveal a steady decline in scale misallocation following reform, mirroring higher recovery rates and shorter insolvency durations, leading to a 3.5% productivity gain over 5 years. We present additional firm-level evidence substantiating these gains: reforms reduce debt among distressed and zombie firms, increase their borrowing costs, and enable previously credit-constrained firms to access greater funding for investment, thereby improving overall capital allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究破产法改革能否减少资本错配。通过分解金融错配为"组成错配"（杠杆分布低效）和"规模错配"（资本分配次优），利用22个经济体2003-2024年企业数据，发现有效改革显著降低规模错配，尤其在困境企业和僵尸企业集中的行业，并带来5年内3.5%的生产率提升。
AI.research_question: 破产法改革能否减少资本错配？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 在破产制度薄弱的经济体中，困境企业和僵尸企业普遍存在，造成资本错配和资源浪费。然而，破产法改革能否有效改善资本配置效率，缺乏系统性的理论和实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融错配分解框架：将资本错配区分为"组成错配"（杠杆在企业的低效分布）和"规模错配"（资本在企业间的次优配置），前者反映资本结构扭曲，后者反映资源配置效率。
AI.method: 基于22个经济体2003-2024年的企业层面数据，采用事件研究法，分析破产法改革前后资本错配指标的变化，并结合行业异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）有效的破产改革显著降低规模错配，尤其在困境企业和僵尸企业集中的行业；（2）改革后规模错配持续下降，伴随更高的回收率和更短的破产持续时间；（3）改革带来5年内3.5%的生产率提升；（4）改革减少困境和僵尸企业的债务、提高其借贷成本，同时使此前受信贷约束的企业获得更多投资资金。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了资本错配的二元分解框架（组成错配 vs. 规模错配），为理解破产制度如何影响资源配置效率提供了更精细的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了破产法改革能带来实质性经济收益（生产率提升3.5%）的实证依据，并揭示了改革通过"清理僵尸企业、释放信贷资源"改善资本配置的具体机制。

title: The 6 GHz Policy Trade-off: Wi-Fi Access, Economic Value, and Europe's Digital Future
affiliations: , Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC Barcelona Tech) and Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC Barcelona Tech)

detail.title: The 6 GHz Policy Trade-off: Wi-Fi Access, Economic Value, and Europe's Digital Future

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported in part by the Spanish MCIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033/FEDER/UE under project PID2023-146378NB-I00 and by the open-science research Grant \#2025-365205 from the Silicon Valley Community Foundation by recommendation of Cisco.

detail.abstract: Wireless connectivity, and Wi-Fi in particular, has become a major driver of value in the digital economy. As applications increasingly demand lower latency, higher reliability, and multigigabit speeds, the 6 GHz band has emerged as a critical resource. While regions such as the United States have opened the full 5925 to 7125 MHz range for unlicensed use, Europe has taken a more conservative approach. Today, only the lower 6 GHz band (5945-6425 MHz) is harmonized in Europe, primarily for low-power indoor operation. The upper 6 GHz band (6425-7125 MHz) remains under discussion, with regulators considering different options for sharing or prioritization between mobile networks and Wi-Fi. This article assesses the case for expanding unlicensed access to 6 GHz in the European Union (EU-27), with emphasis on the upper 6 GHz band, by linking technical performance gains to macroeconomic outcomes. In particular, we outline the current regulatory framework, quantify the technical benefits of allowing the full band for Wi-Fi use, and present an economic analysis of the opportunity cost of limiting Wi-Fi access to only the lower portion of the 6 GHz band across the EU. Our estimations indicate that the EU may forgo €8,125 million in gross domestic product (GDP) in 2025, rising to €11,275 million in 2030, due to constrained growth in the access network quality index under continued restrictions on Wi-Fi access to the upper 6 GHz band, for a total GDP uplift of €58,366 million in the six-year period.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了欧盟开放6 GHz全频段（尤其是上6 GHz频段）用于Wi-Fi的案例，通过技术性能与宏观经济分析，指出若继续限制Wi-Fi接入上6 GHz频段，欧盟在2025-2030年间可能累计损失583.66亿欧元的GDP。
AI.research_question: 欧盟是否有必要将6 GHz全频段（特别是上6 GHz频段）开放给Wi-Fi等非授权使用？
AI.motivation: 无线连接日益重要，6 GHz频段成为关键资源。美国已开放全频段，但欧洲仅开放下6 GHz频段，上6 GHz频段仍在讨论中。需要量化限制Wi-Fi接入上6 GHz频段的经济成本，为监管决策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将技术性能提升（如网络质量指数）与宏观经济结果（GDP）联系起来的经济分析框架。
AI.method: 1）梳理当前监管框架；2）量化允许全频段用于Wi-Fi的技术收益；3）通过经济分析估算限制Wi-Fi仅使用下6 GHz频段的机会成本。
AI.findings: 若继续限制Wi-Fi接入上6 GHz频段，欧盟2025年可能损失81.25亿欧元GDP，2030年损失112.75亿欧元，六年累计GDP损失达583.66亿欧元。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了从无线频谱技术性能提升到宏观经济产出的量化分析路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟监管机构关于6 GHz频段分配（移动网络与Wi-Fi之间的共享或优先级划分）提供了量化经济依据，表明开放全频段具有显著的经济收益。

reference: Universidad Internacional San Isidro Labrador Research Paper
title: Percepciones comunitarias y conflictos socioambientales en torno a la pesca deportiva en Costa Rica: un enfoque desde el desarrollo sostenible (Community Perceptions and Socio-Environmental Conflicts Around Sport Fishing in Costa Rica: A Sustainable Development Approach)
affiliations: Universidad Internacional San Isidro Labrador - UISIL

detail.title: Percepciones comunitarias y conflictos socioambientales en torno a la pesca deportiva en Costa Rica: un enfoque desde el desarrollo sostenible (Community Perceptions and Socio-Environmental Conflicts Around Sport Fishing in Costa Rica: A Sustainable Development Approach)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Universidad Internacional San Isidro Labrador Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Universidad Internacional San Isidro Labrador Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Spanish Abstract: La pesca deportiva ha emergido como una actividad estratégica dentro del modelo de economía azul en Costa Rica, particularmente en el litoral Pacífico. Sin embargo, su expansión ha generado tensiones entre actores locales, cuestionando su contribución efectiva al desarrollo sostenible. El presente estudio analiza las percepciones comunitarias y los conflictos socioambientales asociados a la pesca deportiva en comunidades del Pacífico costarricense, mediante un enfoque mixto secuencial explicativo. Se aplicaron encuestas a 100 actores locales y entrevistas a informantes clave en cuatro zonas: Quepos, Herradura, Golfito y Flamingo. Los resultados evidencian que, aunque la actividad es percibida como generadora de ingresos, existen conflictos relacionados con la exclusión social, el acceso a recursos marinos y la débil gobernanza participativa. Se concluye que la pesca deportiva contribuye al desarrollo sostenible únicamente cuando se articula con mecanismos de inclusión comunitaria y regulación ambiental efectiva.

English Abstract: Sport fishing has emerged as a strategic activity within the blue economy model in Costa Rica, particularly along the Pacific coast. However, its expansion has generated tensions among local stakeholders, questioning its effective contribution 35 San Isidro de Pérez Zeledón, Costa Rica Revista Académica El Labrador to sustainable development. This study analyzes community perceptions and socioenvironmental conflicts associated with sport fishing in Pacific coastal communities through a sequential explanatory mixed-methods approach. Surveys were conducted with 100 local stakeholders and interviews with key informants across four locations: Quepos, Herradura, Golfito, and Flamingo. Results indicate that although the activity is perceived as a source of income, conflicts arise from social exclusion, access to marine resources, and weak participatory governance. The study concludes that sport fishing contributes to sustainable development only when aligned with inclusive governance mechanisms and effective environmental regulation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法分析了哥斯达黎加太平洋沿岸社区对体育钓鱼的感知及其引发的社会-环境冲突，发现该活动虽能带来收入，但存在社会排斥、资源获取和治理薄弱等问题，只有在包容性治理和环境监管下才能促进可持续发展。
AI.research_question: 哥斯达黎加太平洋沿岸社区对体育钓鱼的社区感知和社会-环境冲突是什么？体育钓鱼是否对可持续发展有有效贡献？
AI.motivation: 体育钓鱼作为蓝色经济战略活动在哥斯达黎加迅速扩张，但其对可持续发展的实际贡献受到质疑，当地社区间存在紧张关系，因此需要系统分析其社会-环境效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 蓝色经济理论、可持续发展理论、社区参与和治理理论
AI.method: 顺序解释性混合方法：对4个地区（Quepos、Herradura、Golfito、Flamingo）的100名当地利益相关者进行问卷调查，并对关键知情人进行深度访谈。
AI.findings: 体育钓鱼被感知为收入来源，但存在社会排斥、海洋资源获取冲突和薄弱的参与式治理问题；只有在包容性治理和环境有效监管下才能促进可持续发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 将冲突视角和社区感知分析引入蓝色经济和体育钓鱼的可持续发展研究中，揭示了体育钓鱼与可持续发展之间的条件性关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哥斯达黎加及其他地区的蓝色经济发展政策提供实证依据，强调体育钓鱼活动需要融入社区参与机制和环境监管，以实现真正的可持续发展。

reference: MIT Center for Real Estate Research Paper No. 26/05
title: Bits and Mortar: The Microspatial Economics of Data Centers
affiliations: Department of Economics, Oklahoma State University , Oklahoma State University - Stillwater - Spears School of Business and Samuel Talk Lee Professor of Urban and Real Estate Sustainability, Faculty Director of MIT Center for Real Estate

detail.title: Bits and Mortar: The Microspatial Economics of Data Centers

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Center for Real Estate Research Paper No. 26/05
publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Center for Real Estate Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using a building-level panel of U.S. data center entries (2010-2024), we train a convolutional neural network to predict facility entry at 500-meter resolution. The model uncovers a structural bifurcation: hyperscale cloud providers prioritize power capacity, connectivity, and regulatory stability, whereas third-party colocation firms prioritize power access and land affordability. Counterfactual simulations through 2030 reveal that AI-driven demand intensifies constraints in established hubs. In contrast, on-site power generation and renewable grid expansion redistribute development toward previously unviable regions, demonstrating that the geographic equilibrium of data centers is highly sensitive to energy policy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2010-2024年美国数据中心进入的面板数据，训练卷积神经网络预测500米分辨率的设施进入，揭示了超大规模云提供商与第三方托管商在选址上的结构性分叉，并通过反事实模拟发现AI需求加剧枢纽城市约束，而现场发电和可再生能源扩张可重塑数据中心地理分布。
AI.research_question: 数据中心选址的关键驱动因素是什么？不同类型的运营商（超大规模云提供商 vs. 第三方托管商）在选址决策上是否存在结构性差异？能源政策如何影响数据中心的地理分布？
AI.motivation: 随着AI需求激增，数据中心建设加速，但对其选址决策的微观机制和不同类型运营商的行为差异缺乏系统性的定量研究，尤其是能源政策对空间均衡的影响尚未被充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地理空间经济学、机器学习预测模型、反事实模拟分析
AI.method: 使用2010-2024年美国建筑级数据中心进入面板数据，采用卷积神经网络（CNN）在500米空间分辨率下进行设施进入预测，并进行2030年反事实情景模拟。
AI.findings: （1）超大规模云提供商优先考虑电力容量、网络连接性和监管稳定性；（2）第三方托管商优先考虑电力接入和土地 affordability；（3）AI驱动的需求加剧了已建立枢纽城市的资源约束；（4）现场发电和可再生能源电网扩展使数据中心向先前不可行的地区重新分布。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数据中心选址中运营商类型的结构性分叉（bifurcation）现象，将能源政策与空间地理均衡联系起来，为数字基础设施区位理论提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据中心运营商、政策制定者和电网规划者提供了选址决策和能源政策的量化依据，表明可再生能源扩张可缓解枢纽城市压力并促进区域均衡发展。

title: Personality and Life-Cycle Labour Earnings
affiliations: and University of Bonn - Department of Economics

detail.title: Personality and Life-Cycle Labour Earnings
detail.abstract: Labour market inequality over the life cycle reflects differences not only in wages, but also in employment stability, and career progression. While a large literature documents that personality traits predict wages and other labour market outcomes, little is known about how they shape accumulated earnings over the working life. This paper studies the relationship between personality traits, risk preferences, locus of control, and accumulated labour earnings up to age 45. We combine German administrative social-security records with long-running survey data, allowing us to link complete employment and earnings biographies to established measures of personality. We show that personality traits are strongly associated with long-run earnings, but through different mechanisms. Conscientiousness and an internal locus of control are positively related to accumulated earnings, whereas agreeableness, neuroticism, and, particularly for women, extraversion are negatively associated with earnings accumulation. Decomposing accumulated earnings into wage and employment components reveals substantial heterogeneity in the channels through which personality shapes long-run outcomes. The results highlight that the role of personality for economic success cannot be fully understood from cross-sectional wage measures alone.

AI.tldr: 本文利用德国行政社保记录与长期调查数据，研究人格特质、风险偏好、控制点与45岁前累积劳动收入的关系。发现尽责性、内控点与累积收入正相关，宜人性、神经质和外向性（尤其女性）负相关，且人格特质通过工资和就业不同渠道影响长期经济表现。
AI.research_question: 人格特质如何影响个体直至45岁的累积劳动收入？其作用机制（工资 vs 就业渠道）是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有文献多关注人格特质对工资等截面结果的影响，但缺乏对累积劳动收入（综合工资、就业稳定性、职业晋升）的长期研究。仅从截面工资难以全面理解人格特质的经济意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人格心理学（大五人格）、劳动经济学（人力资本理论、职业选择理论）、行为经济学（风险偏好、控制点）。
AI.method: 将德国行政社保记录（完整就业与收入历史）与长期调查数据（人格特质测量）匹配，采用分解方法将累积收入拆分为工资成分和就业成分，分析人格特质通过不同渠道的作用。
AI.findings: 1. 尽责性、内控点与累积收入正相关；宜人性、神经质、外向性（尤其女性）负相关。2. 人格特质通过工资和就业不同渠道起作用，存在显著异质性。3. 仅用截面工资无法充分理解人格对长期经济成功的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了人格经济学的研究视角，从截面工资转向累积收入（生命周期的综合指标），揭示人格特质通过不同机制（工资 vs 就业）影响长期经济表现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和雇主提供参考：评估个体长期经济成功时需关注人格特质；教育和职业干预可针对尽责性、内控点等促进职业稳定性和收入积累。

title: Topological Experiments for Graph Distributions: Information Loss, Separation and Identifiability in Network Populations
affiliations: and Beijing Institute of Technology

detail.title: Topological Experiments for Graph Distributions: Information Loss, Separation and Identifiability in Network Populations
detail.abstract: A graph distribution Q ∈ P(Gm) on unlabelled simple graphs is ob served only through a topological summary Φ : Gm → Z, inducing the topological law TΦ(Q) := Φ#Q. We study the experiment Etop(Q,Φ) = (Z,{Φ#Q}Q∈Q)asadeterministic randomisation of the raw graph experi ment EG(Q) in the Le Cam–Blackwell sense, and obtain identifiability of the recoverable quotient, information loss to the raw experiment, incomparability with a four-summary classical panel, identifiability of a declared coarse mechanism parameter, and stability under empirical sampling and choice of filtration. The default summary Φ0 is the pair (Dgm0,Dgm1) of the edge insertion clique-complex filtration with universal cap Dm = m 2 + 1. The main results are: (T1) admissibility of any Borel, isomorphism-invariant, Lipschitz Φ together with a Lipschitz push-forward bound for TΦ; (T2) exact characterisation of the identifiable quotient Q/≡Φ; (T3) a two-point sub-experiment on which EG has minimax risk 0 and E0 has minimax risk 1/2, hence δ(E0 → EG) ≥1/2; (T4) Blackwell incomparability of E0 with each of the four classical summaries edge density, degree sequence, adja cency spectrum, and triangle count, witnessed by explicit pairs at base sizes mbase ∈{3,4,5,6} padded to a common m≥7; (T5) functional identifiability of a declared one-dimensional coarse parameter θ(Q) = PrQ(M1 > 0) on a fixed tree-versus-chordless-cycle submodel Qtc, in the sense that θ fac tors through T0 on Qtc; the result is internal to this declared submodel and is not claimed to recover unknown component laws in richer mixture models; (T6) empirical convergence E[W1(Φ# Qn,Φ#Q)] ≤ CTVLΦ |Gm|/n, giving the standard n−1/2 rate for fixed m; the bound contains the support size factor |Gm|1/2 ≤ 2m 2 /2 and the summary-dependent constant LΦ, the latter admitting a crude fixed-m polynomial envelope for the default Φ0 (Remark 3.4) with sharp or dimension-uniform constants not pursued here; (T7) filtration stability at the diagram and feature levels, with the law-level W1,dB-discrepancy of two filtrations bounded by their expected interleaving distance; (T8) persistent non-vanishing information loss: δ(E0(P(Gm)) → EG(P(Gm))) ≥1/2 for every m≥4. Six computational cells provide audit checks: they reproduce the witness computations of T3, T4, T8 and illustrate the Bernoulli finite-sample behaviour underlying T5 and the bottleneck stability prediction of T7; the simulations are not part of the proofs.

AI.tldr: 本文从Le Cam-Blackwell统计决策理论视角，系统研究了基于拓扑摘要（如持续同调）观察图分布时的统计可识别性、信息损失、实验比较等问题，提出了理论框架并给出了若干关键结果。
AI.research_question: 当图分布仅通过拓扑摘要（如持续同调图）被观测时，原始图实验与拓扑摘要实验之间的统计信息关系如何？具体涉及可识别性、信息损失、实验比较、参数可识别性、经验收敛和滤波稳定性等问题。
AI.motivation: 实际中图数据常以拓扑摘要形式被观测，但这类摘要对原始图分布的信息保留程度缺乏严格的统计学理论分析，作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Le Cam-Blackwell统计决策理论、持续同调（persistent homology）、拓扑数据分析、 minimax风险、Blackwell可比较性、Wasserstein距离、交错距离（interleaving distance）。
AI.method: 将拓扑摘要视为原始图实验的确定性随机化（deterministic randomization），利用Le Cam-Blackwell框架分析实验间的风险下界、可识别商、两点子实验构造、经验收敛性分析等。
AI.findings: (T1) Lipschitz拓扑摘要的可容许性和推送界；(T2) 可识别商的特征刻画；(T3) 存在两点子实验使原始图实验minimax风险为0而拓扑摘要实验为1/2；(T4) 拓扑摘要实验与四种经典图摘要（边密度、度序列、邻接谱、三角形计数）Blackwell不可比较；(T5) 在特定子模型上粗参数θ可通过拓扑摘要函数可识别；(T6) 经验收敛率为n^{-1/2}；(T7) 滤波稳定性；(T8) 信息损失持续非零。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Le Cam-Blackwell统计决策理论系统引入拓扑数据分析与图统计的交叉领域，严格刻画了拓扑摘要对图分布的信息损失，证明了拓扑摘要实验与经典统计量实验的不可比较性，建立了拓扑实验统计推断的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用持续同调等拓扑摘要分析图数据的实践者提供了信息损失的理论边界，指导在何种条件下拓扑摘要可识别目标参数，以及经验样本量与收敛速率的关系；六组计算细胞验证了关键理论结果。

title: Transforming African Public Debt into Productive Concessionary Assets:  The African Debt-for-Development Concession (ADDC) Framework

detail.title: Transforming African Public Debt into Productive Concessionary Assets:  The African Debt-for-Development Concession (ADDC) Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is conceptual and methodological. It does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, interviews, surveys, experiments, or case-study subjects requiring informed consent. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The paper was prepared independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This public working paper develops a conceptual and quantitative framework for transforming a portion of African public debt into productive concessionary assets through an instrument called the African Debt-for-Development Concession, abbreviated as ADDC. The paper starts from a historical problem: public debt has expanded globally and in Africa, but many borrowing cycles have not produced a sufficient stock of self-liquidating productive assets. Conventional restructuring, refinancing and relief can reduce liquidity pressure, yet they do not automatically create ports, logistics corridors, energy platforms, industrial zones, digital infrastructure or export capacity. ADDC therefore reframes part of the debt question as a conversion problem: under what conditions can a sovereign claim be reorganised into economic rights linked to a governed productive asset? The paper integrates debt-for-development swaps, sovereign recovery analysis, public-private partnerships, concession governance, special economic zones and institutional economics. Its main contribution is a dual-sided public model: a debtor eligibility logic, a creditor attractiveness logic and a joint viability rule. The public version keeps the equations general and the stress tests stylised. It is intended as an academic screening framework, not as a complete transaction manual.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"非洲债务换发展特许权"(ADDC)的概念与定量框架，旨在将非洲部分公共债务转化为生产性让步资产，通过债务人资格、债权人吸引力和联合可行性三方面的双面公共模型，解决债务循环未能产生足够自偿性生产资产的历史问题。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，主权债权可以被重组为与受治理生产性资产相关的经济权利？
AI.motivation: 全球及非洲公共债务持续扩张，但许多借贷周期未能产生足够的自偿性生产资产存量。传统的债务重组、再融资和减免虽能缓解流动性压力，却无法自动创造港口、物流走廊、能源平台、工业区、数字基础设施或出口能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了债务换发展互换、主权复苏分析、公私合作伙伴关系、特许权治理、经济特区及制度经济学等多领域理论。
AI.method: 概念与定量框架开发，包含双面公共模型：债务人资格逻辑、债权人吸引力逻辑及联合可行性规则。方程保持一般性，压力测试采用风格化处理，作为学术筛选框架而非完整交易手册。
AI.findings: ADDC框架提供了一种将部分债务问题重构为转换问题的方案，通过双面公共模型评估债务转换的可行性条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将债务换发展特许权与主权复苏分析、PPP、特许权治理、经济特区及制度经济学整合为一个统一的分析框架，并提出了债务人-债权人双面公共模型及联合可行性规则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和国际金融机构提供了一种学术筛选工具，用于评估将公共债务转化为生产性让步资产的可行条件，有助于推动非洲债务问题的结构性解决。

title: Large Language Model-Enhanced Feedback for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning-Based Optimal Control of Data Center Cooling
affiliations: Xi'an University of Architecture & Technology, Xi'an University of Architecture & Technology, Xi'an University of Architecture & Technology, Xi'an University of Architecture & Technology, Xi'an University of Architecture & Technology and Xi'an Hi-Rate Electrical Power Technology Co

detail.title: Large Language Model-Enhanced Feedback for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning-Based Optimal Control of Data Center Cooling
detail.abstract: Data center cooling is a major source of non-IT energy consumption, and optimal cooling control must reduce power consumption while maintaining safe rack inlet air temperatures. To address insufficient state representation, credit-assignment difficulty, and limited reward expressiveness in strongly coupled cooling control, this paper proposes LEF-MARL, a large-language-model-enhanced multi-agent reinforcement learning framework. The cooling task is decomposed into three cooperative agents, and coupling, dynamic, and power-related information is incorporated into local observations. A domain-knowledge-prompted large language model is used as an offline preference annotator to express high-level operational criteria, including thermal safety, energy efficiency, and cooling-loop coordination, as pairwise comparisons of candidate operating states. These comparisons are converted into continuous state scores using the Thurstone-Mosteller model, and the learned scores are further used to construct preference-score difference rewards, providing dense and agent-attributable learning signals without online LLM inference. A simulation environment is developed using a high-density AI data center prototype, real operational data, and meteorological data. Compared with four baselines across seven representative operating conditions, LEF-MARL achieves the lowest average cooling power and average PUE, namely 42.36 kW and 1.233, while maintaining an average rack inlet air temperature of 24.48 °C without temperature violations. It reduces average cooling power by 19.32% over rule-based control and by 2.93% over the best learning-based baseline, while eliminating residual overheating violations. The ablation results support the effectiveness of dynamically coupled state representation and the proposed preference-score difference reward construction mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEF-MARL框架，利用大语言模型增强多智能体强化学习，优化数据中心冷却控制，在降低能耗的同时确保热安全，实验表明相比基线方法平均冷却功耗降低19.32%，PUE达到1.233。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型增强多智能体强化学习，解决数据中心冷却控制中状态表征不足、信用分配困难及奖励表达能力有限的问题？
AI.motivation: 数据中心冷却是非IT能耗的主要来源，现有强化学习方法面临状态表征不足、信用分配困难和奖励表达能力有限三大挑战，亟需更优的冷却控制框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）、大语言模型（LLM）、Thurstone-Mosteller模型、偏好评分差奖励机制
AI.method: 将冷却任务分解为三个协作智能体；利用领域知识提示的LLM作为离线偏好标注器，生成状态对比较；通过Thurstone-Mosteller模型将比较结果转化为连续状态评分；构建偏好评分差奖励提供密集且可归因的学习信号；基于高密度AI数据中心原型、真实运行数据和气象数据构建仿真环境。
AI.findings: LEF-MARL在七种工况下实现平均冷却功耗42.36 kW、平均PUE 1.233、平均机柜进风温度24.48°C且无温度违规；相比基于规则的控制降低19.32%冷却功耗，相比最优学习基线降低2.93%；消融实验验证了动态耦合状态表征和偏好评分差奖励机制的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出LLM增强的MARL框架，创新性地将LLM作为离线偏好标注器以表达高层运行标准；提出偏好评分差奖励机制，提供密集且智能体可归因的学习信号，无需在线LLM推理。
AI.practical_contributions: 显著降低数据中心冷却能耗和PUE，消除残余过热违规，为实际数据中心冷却控制提供了高效、可落地的AI解决方案。

title: Climate Variability, Food Security, and the Geopolitics of Growth in Africa: An Econometric and Political Economy Analysis
affiliations: The Open University of Sri Lanka, University of Colombo and Open University of Sri Lanka

detail.title: Climate Variability, Food Security, and the Geopolitics of Growth in Africa: An Econometric and Political Economy Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper examines the drivers of economic growth in Africa through the lenses of geopolitics and political economy. Africa is among the most structurally diverse continents and has faced challenges over the years, but some countries have also experienced accelerated economic growth in recent years. However, this growth remains rather uneven and is highly susceptible to global economic shocks that affect growth rates across countries in various parts of Africa. This paper argues that growth outcomes in African countries are fundamentally conditional, shaped not only by exposure to global markets but also by the institutional and policy environments through which external forces operate. Using a panel dataset of 42 African countries from 1961 to 2024, the study finds that greater integration into global trade and better macroeconomic and governance performance are crucial determinants of economic growth in the region. Governance and policy factors can foster macroeconomic discipline, thereby improving growth performance. On the other hand, persistent inflation is a significant negative determinant of economic growth, which shows the need for monetary stability. External imbalances in these countries show mixed effects, reflecting the dual role of foreign financing: sometimes an opportunity, other times a constraint. Governance indicators, such as government effectiveness, are positively associated with growth in the selected group of countries, suggesting that growth benefits from higher-quality institutions. The robustness tests in this paper include alternative development measures and controls for food security and climate-related factors, thereby reinforcing the study's main findings.

AI.tldr: 本文基于1961-2024年42个非洲国家的面板数据，从地缘政治和政治经济学视角分析了非洲经济增长的驱动因素，发现全球市场融合、宏观经济与治理表现是增长的关键决定因素，而持续通胀则显著抑制增长。
AI.research_question: 非洲经济增长的驱动因素是什么？地缘政治和政治经济学因素如何影响非洲各国的经济增长差异？
AI.motivation: 非洲经济增长虽在加速但仍极不平衡，且易受全球经济冲击影响。现有研究对非洲经济结构性差异及制度环境如何调节外部冲击的研究不足，因此有必要从地缘政治和政治经济学视角系统分析其增长驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济增长的条件性论点：增长结果不仅受全球市场暴露程度影响，还受到制度环境和政策环境的调节。涉及地缘政治经济学、制度经济学等理论。
AI.method: 采用42个非洲国家1961年至2024年的面板数据集，结合替代发展指标、粮食安全和气候相关因素进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）全球贸易整合程度越高、宏观经济与治理表现越好，经济增长越快；（2）持续通胀显著负向影响增长；（3）外部失衡呈现混合效应，反映外资融资的双刃剑作用；（4）政府有效性等治理指标与增长正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证并拓展了"增长条件性"理论，揭示了全球市场暴露与制度/政策环境对非洲经济增长的交互作用机制，丰富了发展经济学和政治经济学在非洲情境下的理论对话。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家政策制定提供实证依据：应加强全球贸易整合、维持货币稳定、提升政府治理效能，同时审慎管理外部融资风险，并关注粮食安全与气候因素对增长的潜在影响。

reference: Singapore Management University School of Law Research Paper Forthcoming; Journal of Business Law (Forthcoming 2026)
title: Against Crypto Exceptionalism in Financial Regulation
affiliations: Singapore Management University - Yong Pung How School of Law

detail.title: Against Crypto Exceptionalism in Financial Regulation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Singapore Management University School of Law Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Singapore Management University Yong Pung How School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Across jurisdictions, regulators either construct a sui generis legal category for crypto-assets, as in the European Union and the United Kingdom, or insert crypto intermediation into legal categories designed for other functions, most notably payment services in Singapore and historically Japan. In each case, however, the substantive obligations imposed-disclosure, custody and segregation of client assets, governance duties, prudential safeguards and marketintegrity prohibitions-are not crypto-native. They are transplanted from traditional capitalmarkets, custody and financial-services law. Through a comparative analysis of the European Union, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong and the United Kingdom, contrasted with Switzerland and Canada, this article shows that crypto regulation rarely governs a fundamentally new legal object. Rather, it relabels familiar forms of financial intermediation and reapplies established doctrines under a novel regulatory perimeter. The result of this regulatory strategy is duplication, weakened technology neutrality and conceptual instability at the boundary between payments law, securities law and prudential regulation. The article therefore argues against crypto exceptionalism in financial regulation. It defends a functional alternative under which regulation follows the economic activity performed, rather than the crypto label attached to the instrument or service, and it concludes that crypto exceptionalism should be resisted because it fragments financial law without demonstrating corresponding gains in investor protection, consumer protection or financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较欧盟、新加坡、日本、香港、英国、瑞士和加拿大的加密资产监管框架，论证了现行加密监管并未创造真正的新型法律对象，而是将传统金融中介的法律义务（披露、托管、治理、审慎监管等）移植到加密领域，导致法律重复、技术中性受损和概念边界不稳定。作者反对"加密例外主义"，主张按经济功能而非加密标签进行监管。
AI.research_question: 现行各法域对加密资产的监管是否真正创造了新型法律对象？加密"例外主义"（为加密资产专设独特法律类别）是否合理？
AI.motivation: 不同法域对加密资产采取了不同的监管策略（设专门类别 vs. 纳入现有支付服务框架），但实质上都将传统金融法义务移植到加密领域。这种策略可能导致法律体系碎片化，且未必带来投资者保护或金融稳定的提升，需要系统性地批判性审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法学方法；功能监管理论（regulation follows economic function）；技术中性原则；法律移植与制度同构理论。
AI.method: 比较法学分析。选取欧盟、新加坡、日本、香港、英国作为主要研究对象，以瑞士和加拿大作为对照案例，对比不同法域对加密资产的法律分类策略及相关义务体系。
AI.findings: 1) 各法域加密监管并未创造真正的"加密原生"法律义务，核心规则（披露、托管、治理、审慎、市场诚信）均移植自传统资本市场法和金融中介法。2) 无论是设专门类别（欧盟、英国）还是纳入现有类别（新加坡、日本），结果都是对传统金融中介形式的重新标签化。3) 这种策略导致：法律义务重复、技术中性受损、支付法/证券法/审慎监管之间的边界概念不稳定。4) 加密例外主义应被抵制，因为它碎片化金融法却未带来对应的投资者保护、消费者保护或金融稳定收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了批判"加密例外主义"的系统性理论论证；揭示了加密监管的"法律移植"本质——看似创新，实则是传统金融法义务在新型监管边界下的重新应用；从法律碎片化、技术中性受损、概念不稳定三个维度构建了反对加密例外主义的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了监管思路的替代方案——按经济功能（而非资产标签）进行监管的功能性监管路径；警示了现行监管策略可能带来的法律体系内在矛盾和效率损失；对各国正在进行的加密监管立法具有直接的参考价值。
